name: Roseburg Forest Products
description: Roseburg Forest Products, a privately owned company founded in 1936, manufactures diverse wood products like lumber, plywood, and engineered wood for North American construction and furniture markets. Operating numerous facilities across the U.S., it also manages extensive timberlands, though its California veneer plant in Weed recently closed.

name: Land O'Lakes Industrial Cheese
description: Land O'Lakes is a farmer-owned cooperative, established in 1921, that produces a variety of dairy products including butter, cheese, eggs, and whipping cream. They serve consumers by offering products and recipes, emphasizing their farmer-owners and the quality of their dairy items.

name: Saputo Cheese USA
description: Saputo Cheese USA transforms milk into high-quality, safe, and nutritious cheese and dairy products, serving consumers across the U.S. They offer a vast array of award-winning products and well-known brands, including mozzarella, provolone, blue cheese, cheddar, Monterey Jack, goat, hard Italian cheeses, feta, string, snacking, and ricotta.

name: Sun Pacific
description: Sun Pacific is a California-based agricultural company that grows, packs, and ships fresh produce, including Cuties® mandarins, Mighties® kiwi, oranges, Air Chief® grapes, and lemons. They serve consumers by providing a variety of fruits, focusing on quality from farm to table.

name: Monrovia Nursery
description: Monrovia Nursery grows and sells a wide variety of plants, including shrubs, perennials, trees, and edibles. Serving both home gardeners and landscape professionals, the company offers distinctive selections and resources, operating for over 100 years with a focus on developing strong root systems.

name: Winco Foods
description: WinCo Foods is an employee-owned supermarket chain operating across multiple states, including California. It offers a wide range of groceries, including produce, meat, deli, seafood, and bakery items, focusing on providing low prices and extra savings to its customers.

name: Tulare Local Healthcare District
description: The Tulare Local Healthcare District manages and utilizes District resources to address the health needs of its population. It provides governance, oversight, and stewardship of healthcare assets and capital projects, supporting community wellness and public accountability, including the construction of the Tulare Tower.

name: Tulare Joint Union High School District
description: The Tulare Joint Union High School District operates three comprehensive high schools, one continuation high school, one community day school, two charter high schools, and an adult school in Tulare, CA. It focuses on fostering student success and preparing students for future possibilities, with a high graduation rate and strong academic progress.

name: Porterville College
description: Porterville College is an educational institution that provides academic and career pathways in fields like Business, Health, Arts, and Public Safety. It serves new students, athletes, international students, high school students, and military veterans, offering support services such as counseling, health & wellness, and tutoring.

name: Visalia Medical Clinic
description: Visalia Medical Clinic, part of Adventist Health, has served the Visalia community for over 80 years, offering primary care, pediatrics, and over 18 specialties. They provide comprehensive healthcare services for patients from birth through adulthood at their main and surrounding locations, including quick care and various specialty clinics.

name: BASS Medical Group
description: BASS Medical Group is a healthcare provider offering compassionate primary care and specialty services, including cancer and imaging centers, to communities across the San Francisco Bay Area. With over 200 locations and hundreds of doctors, they serve a wide range of patients with advanced technology and diverse medical expertise.

name: Adventist Health Tulare
description: Adventist Health provides faith-based, comprehensive healthcare services across the West Coast and Hawaii. It offers primary, urgent, and specialty care, including cancer, women's health, and emergency services, focusing on mental, physical, and spiritual wellness to help communities live to their fullest potential.

name: Kaweah Health Rehabilitation Hospital
description: Kaweah Health is a healthcare organization in Tulare County, California, offering a wide range of services including emergency, cardiovascular, cancer care, orthopedics, and rehabilitation. With 52 locations, it serves the community by providing comprehensive medical care and promoting healthiness.

name: Porterville Developmental Center
description: Porterville Developmental Center is California's only state-operated facility serving individuals with mild to moderate intellectual disabilities who have legal system contact, are a danger to themselves or others, or are incompetent to stand trial. It provides personalized support, treatment, and training programs, including healthcare, education, and independent living skills, to maximize independence.

name: Sierra View Medical Center
description: Sierra View Medical Center is a 167-bed, full-service acute care facility in Porterville, California, serving the Southern Sequoia region of Tulare County. It provides comprehensive healthcare services, including an Advanced Primary Stroke Center, cancer treatment, and a Urology Clinic in alliance with Keck Medicine of USC.

name: Tulare County Office of Education
description: The Tulare County Office of Education provides comprehensive educational programs and services, including early childhood, special education, and college and career readiness, to students and school districts across Tulare County. Key activities involve instructional support, professional learning, and operating various educational sites and student events.

name: Foster Farms
description: Foster Farms is a West Coast poultry producer offering premium chicken and turkey products, ranging from fresh whole chickens to ready-to-eat meals like wings and nuggets. They serve consumers and food service operations, focusing on responsibly raised poultry with no added hormones or steroids.

name: Woolf Farming Company of California
description: Woolf Farming and Processing operates in California's Central Valley, sustainably growing, processing, and delivering healthy natural products to the food chain. As a certified B Corp, they adhere to high standards of social commitment and environmental performance.

name: Clark Brothers Construction
description: Clark Bros. Inc. and CBI Power, Inc. are full-service EPC contractors specializing in heavy civil and high-voltage electrical infrastructure across the western United States. They deliver turnkey solutions for complex projects in water, power, and renewables sectors, including wind, solar, hydro, and battery energy storage systems, serving developers and owners.

name: Fresno Plumbing and Heating
description: Fresno Plumbing and Heating Inc. has provided plumbing services in California's Central Valley since 1945, serving residential and commercial clients, including housing developments, schools, and medical facilities. They offer new construction, service, leak detection, re-piping, water heater services, sewer inspection, and backflow testing, supported by over 260 employees.

name: Anlin Industries
description: Anlin Windows & Doors is a top replacement window and door manufacturer based in Clovis, CA, serving homeowners with energy-efficient vinyl products. They offer a range of windows and patio doors, including options with in-glass pet doors, backed by a Limited Double Lifetime Warranty and 5-star customer service.

name: Sun-Maid Growers of California
description: Sun-Maid Growers of California produces and markets a variety of dried fruit products, including sun-dried raisins, yogurt-covered raisins, dried mango, apricots, prunes, and figs. They serve consumers with snacks and ingredients for baking, emphasizing whole fruit goodness.

name: Lion Raisins
description: Lion Raisins, a five-generation family business since 1903, cultivates and supplies premium raisins and raisin-based products, including Golden and Dried-On-the-Vine varieties. They offer industrial solutions, distribution, and packaging services to customers worldwide, utilizing a state-of-the-art facility in California.

name: Cargill
description: Cargill is a global food corporation that provides food, agriculture, financial, and industrial products and services, working to nourish the world by connecting farmers with markets, customers with ingredients, and people and animals with the food they need.

name: Harris Ranch Beef Company
description: Harris Ranch Beef Company is a beef producer that pioneered a branded beef program in 1982, serving retail, e-commerce, export, and foodservice customers. They process high volumes for large U.S. distributors and customized orders, focusing on animal welfare, sustainability, and stringent food safety standards to produce high-quality beef.

name: Olam Spices and Vegetables
description: ofi (Olam Food Ingredients) is a global food and beverage ingredient supplier, offering cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts, and spices. They serve over 11,000 customers, including CPG, foodservice, and retail, with solutions for bakery, beverages, and snacks, supported by over 120 manufacturing facilities and an integrated global supply chain.

name: Lyons Magnus
description: Lyons Magnus is a leader in the foodservice industry, developing and marketing high-quality products with innovative packaging since 1852. They serve foodservice operators, healthcare providers, and other businesses with ingredients, custom solutions, and co-manufacturing services, including beverage syrups, sauces, and fruit-based products.

name: Selma Kia
description: Selma Kia is a car dealership in Selma, CA, serving the Central Valley by selling new and pre-owned Kia vehicles, including EV/hybrid models. They also offer financing, parts, and a service department for vehicle maintenance and repairs.

name: Home Depot
description: Home Depot is a retail company offering a wide range of products for home improvement, construction, and garden projects. They serve both DIY customers and professionals, providing appliances, building materials, tools, and home décor. The company also offers various services, including professional installation and tool rental.

name: Lowe's Home Improvement
description: Lowe's Home Improvement is a retail organization providing a vast selection of products and services for home renovation, maintenance, and outdoor projects. Serving both homeowners and professionals, it offers appliances, building supplies, tools, lawn & garden items, and installation services to support various home improvement needs.

name: Mission Foods
description: Mission Foods produces a variety of Mexican food products, including flour and corn tortillas, tostadas, wraps, flatbreads, tortilla chips, and salsa. They offer options like low carb, whole wheat, organic, and gluten-free products, serving consumers seeking versatile meal components and snacks.

name: Stamoules Produce Company
description: Stamoules Produce Company is a family-operated business farming over 17,000 acres in California's San Joaquin Valley. For over 80 years, they have grown, packed, and sold fresh produce, including cantaloupes, sweet corn, and bell peppers, for distribution across the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

name: Community Medical Center
description: Community Medical Centers, part of Community Health System, is the fifth-largest healthcare system in California and the largest employer in the Central Valley, operating four inpatient hospitals and various other facilities. It provides comprehensive medical services, including a Level I Trauma Center, cancer care, heart and lung care, and behavioral health services, serving the central San Joaquin Valley.

name: ULTA Beauty Distribution Center
description: ULTA Beauty operates a 670,000 sq ft distribution and e-commerce fulfillment center in Fresno, California. It manages receiving, storing, and shipping over 25,000 beauty products to serve 400 Western US stores and online customers, employing hundreds.

name: Clovis East High School
description: Clovis East High School, part of Clovis Unified School District, provides comprehensive secondary education, including academic, career technical, and co-curricular programs, fostering student development in mind, body, and spirit within the education industry.

name: Clovis High School
description: Clovis High School, a member of Clovis Unified School District, offers a robust secondary education experience with diverse academic pathways, career technical education, and extracurricular activities, operating within the education sector.

name: Roosevelt High School
description: Roosevelt High School, part of Fresno Unified School District, educates approximately 2,200 students in grades 9-12 in southeast Fresno, California. It offers academic programs, including AP courses, and diverse Career Technical Education pathways like medicine, public service, and arts, preparing students for college and careers.

name: Sanger High School
description: Sanger High School, part of Sanger Unified School District, offers a comprehensive high school education, providing students with equitable access to academic, vocational, and extracurricular opportunities to achieve their dreams within the education sector.

name: Clovis Adult Education
description: Clovis Adult Education, part of the Clovis Unified School District, provides educational programs and career technical education pathways. The district serves a large student population across 47 comprehensive and 9 specialty schools in California, focusing on academic, physical, and social-emotional development.

name: Reedley College
description: Reedley College is a public community college offering diverse academic programs, career and technical education, and comprehensive student support services, preparing students for transfer, employment, and lifelong learning in the education sector.

name: California State University Fresno
description: California State University Fresno is a public university serving nearly 24,000 students with undergraduate, post-baccalaureate, and doctoral degree programs across eight schools and colleges. It emphasizes hands-on learning, research, and athletic achievements, preparing students for success and contributing to the Central Valley community.

name: Elm Community Health Center
description: Elm Community Health Center, operating as Clinica Sierra Vista, is a Federally Qualified Health Center delivering comprehensive primary medical, dental, behavioral health, and specialty care services to underserved communities in the healthcare industry.

name: Horizon Health and Subacute Center
description: Horizon Health & Sub-Acute Center in Fresno, CA, provides post-acute and subacute care, including skilled nursing and rehabilitation services. It serves medically complex patients, such as those requiring ventilator care, and offers a 44-bed special treatment program for individuals managing mental illness, focusing on restoring health and well-being.

name: American Ambulance
description: American Ambulance is the sole 9-1-1 provider for Fresno and Kings Counties in Central California, responding to over 175,000 calls annually across 6,500 square miles. They employ over 700 individuals and maintain nearly 100 ground ambulances, offering emergency medical services and community training programs.

name: Adventist Health Reedley
description: Adventist Health is a faith-based healthcare provider offering comprehensive medical services, including primary, urgent, and specialty care, to communities across the West Coast and Hawaii. They focus on whole-person care, supporting mental, physical, and spiritual wellness to help individuals achieve their fullest potential.

name: Adventist Health Selma
description: Adventist Health is a faith-based healthcare provider offering comprehensive services, including primary, urgent, and specialty care, across the West Coast and Hawaii. They focus on mental, physical, and spiritual wellness, serving communities with a network of dedicated specialists.

name: Fresno Heart and Surgical Hospital
description: Fresno Heart & Surgical Hospital is a hotel-like specialty hospital in north Fresno, part of Community Medical Centers. It offers a range of services including heart and lung care, neurosciences, and orthopedics, serving the Central Valley region of California.

name: Fresno VA Hospital Medical Center
description: VA Central California Health Care System provides health care services to Veterans, their families, and caregivers in the Central Valley. Key activities include managing health appointments, refilling prescriptions, and offering mental health care, with facilities like the Fresno VA Medical Center and new clinics such as the one in Visalia.

name: Kaiser Permanente Fresno Medical Center
description: Kaiser Permanente provides custom care and coverage, integrating doctors, hospitals, and health plans to offer convenient access to care across various regions, including Northern and Southern California. They focus on preventive care, offering services like telehealth, pharmacy, and health and wellness resources.

name: Saint Agnes Medical Center
description: Saint Agnes Medical Center is a healthcare provider in California's Central Valley, offering a wide array of services including heart and vascular care, maternity, bariatrics, orthopaedics, and cancer screenings. It serves the community with advanced technology and personalized care, including a Graduate Medical Education program.

name: Palm Village Retirement Community
description: Palm Village is a tax-exempt non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and a licensed Continuing Care Retirement Community (CCRC) in California. It offers five levels of care, including independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, and memory care, serving seniors by providing a secure and healthy living environment, meals, and various activities on its 17-acre campus.

name: John's Incredible Pizza Company
description: John's Incredible Pizza Company offers an all-you-can-eat buffet featuring pizza, pasta, and more, combined with games, indoor rides, and attractions. They serve families and groups, specializing in birthday parties and events. With multiple locations, including several in California, they provide food and entertainment under one roof.

name: China Peak Mountain Resort
description: China Peak Mountain Resort operates a California ski resort, offering winter activities like skiing, snowboarding, lessons, and rentals. It also provides lodging at The Inn, dining, and summer activities such as mountain biking and concerts, serving guests seeking mountain recreation.

name: Fresno County District Attorney
description: The Fresno County District Attorney's office, part of the County of Fresno government, investigates and prosecutes criminal cases, serving the community by upholding justice. Key activities include operating a Bureau of Investigations, providing victim resources, and offering career opportunities.

name: Fresno County Sheriff's Office
description: The Fresno County Sheriff-Coroner's Office provides law enforcement and correctional services to Fresno County, California. Key activities include patrol, investigations, operating the county jail, and coroner services. They serve the public by maintaining safety and providing community resources.

name: Fresno County Superior Court
description: The Superior Court of California, County of Fresno, serves the community by impartially and timely resolving disputes and ensuring compliance with the law. It handles various divisions including Civil, Family Law, Criminal, Juvenile, and Probate, operating across multiple courthouse locations in Fresno.

name: Fresno Police Department
description: The Fresno Police Department serves the City of Fresno, California, with 926 employees, including 811 officers. It ensures public safety by preventing crime, responding to emergencies, and investigating incidents, utilizing specialized units like SWAT and K9.

name: Fresno County Department of Public Health
description: Fresno County Department of Public Health is a government entity providing essential public health services, including environmental health, community health, epidemiology, and emergency services, to protect and improve the well-being of Fresno County residents.

name: Warmerdam Packing
description: Warmerdam Packing is a packing and shipping business that grows and packs cherries, plums, and kiwis. Founded in 1965, their produce is distributed to local grocery stores and shipped globally, demonstrating a significant scale of agricultural operations.

name: Leprino Foods
description: Leprino Foods, established in 1950, is the world's largest producer of mozzarella cheese and a leading manufacturer of whey protein, lactose, and other high-quality dairy ingredients. They sustainably feed and nourish families globally, serving customers as a trusted supplier and business partner.

name: Central Valley Meat Company
description: Central Valley Meat is a family-owned and operated company dedicated to providing high-quality, safe meat products. They prioritize continuous improvement, best-in-class food safety, and humane livestock handling, serving customers with BRC Certified products. The company emphasizes responsibility and sustainability in its operations.

name: Marquez Brothers International
description: Marquez Brothers International, operating as El Mexicano, is a wholesale food company established in 1981. They deliver premium authentic products, including cheeses, creams, yogurts, meats, and desserts, maintaining high standards of quality and freshness. The company serves consumers with products certified by Real Milk Seal, Real California Milk, Halal, and Kosher standards.

name: Lemoore High School
description: Lemoore High School, part of the Lemoore Union High School District, provides comprehensive academic, athletic, and career technical education to students in Lemoore, California. It offers various programs, including college preparatory and career paths, aiming for academic achievement and economic independence for its students.

name: Naval Health Clinic Lemoore
description: Naval Health Clinic Lemoore, part of Naval Medical Forces Pacific, provides comprehensive healthcare services. It serves U.S. Navy and Marine Corps personnel, their families, and Navy civilians, offering medical and dental care, and supporting military readiness within the broader Navy Medicine enterprise.

name: Adventist Health Hanford
description: Adventist Health provides faith-based healthcare services, including primary care, specialty care, urgent care, and hospital services. It serves communities across the West Coast and Hawaii, focusing on whole-person care for mental, physical, and spiritual wellness. Key activities include patient care, community benefit programs, and health equity initiatives.

name: Oasis Date Gardens
description: Oasis Date Gardens is North America's largest date grower and processor, farming over 5,000 acres and harvesting approximately 1 billion dates annually. They are the majority supplier to North America's leading date brand, Natural Delights®, and offer various date products including whole, pitted, pieces, paste, rolls, syrup, powder, and flour.

name: Coachella Valley Water District
description: The Coachella Valley Water District provides domestic water service and manages water resources for the Coachella Valley. It undertakes infrastructure projects like pipeline construction, ensures water quality, and offers customer assistance programs. The District collaborates with other local water agencies and the Agua Caliente Band of Cahuilla Indians.

name: Pacific Hydrotech Corporation
description: Pacific Hydrotech Corporation is an experienced water engineering professional firm serving municipal water districts and oil refining companies across California, Hawaii, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, Alaska, and Washington since 1987. They specialize in concrete tanks, pumping projects, and water/wastewater infrastructure.

name: J Ginger Masonry
description: J Ginger Masonry is a multi-generational firm providing high-quality commercial and residential masonry craftsmanship across the Western United States, including California and Arizona. As one of the largest masonry firms in the West, they combine traditional techniques with modern practices to deliver durable and precise projects.

name: Renova Energy
description: Renova Energy, operating as Mycrogrid, specializes in providing solar and battery solutions with real-time energy control for maximum savings, reliability, and sustainability, aiming for true energy independence in California.

name: Galasso's Bakery
description: Galasso's Bakery, founded in 1968 and located in Southern California, manufactures premium baked goods, specializing in top-tier specialty breads, rolls, and buns. The company serves businesses of any scale, operating from an approximately 115,000 square foot bakery.

name: Monster Beverage Corporation
description: Monster Beverage Corporation, based in Corona, California, is a holding company whose subsidiaries develop and market a wide range of energy drinks, craft beers, hard seltzers, and flavored malt beverages under numerous brands, serving consumers globally.

name: Pepsi Beverages
description: PepsiCo is a global food and beverage company that produces a wide range of snacks and drinks, including brands like Lay's, Pepsi, and Gatorade. It focuses on creating a more resilient and sustainable business, serving consumers worldwide with its diverse product portfolio.

name: Dart Container Corporation
description: Dart Container Corporation manufactures and supplies beverage and food packaging solutions, including containers, dinnerware, cups, lids, and cutlery made from materials like fiber, paper, and foam. They serve businesses with a focus on sustainable practices and recycling programs.

name: Highland Plastics
description: Highland Plastics specializes in custom compounds and extrusion, producing plastic sheets and solutions. They offer services like lamination, prototyping, and custom compounding, serving automotive suppliers and other industries with materials such as flame retardants, acoustic barriers, and high-temperature plastics.

name: CIRCOR Aerospace
description: CIRCOR delivers highly engineered flow control products and services, including pump and valve systems, for mission-critical applications in aerospace and defense. With approximately 3100 employees, they serve customers in over 100 countries across five continents.

name: Collins Aerospace
description: Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, redefines aerospace by designing and delivering advanced solutions for commercial, business, military, and space sectors. They offer a vast portfolio of products and services, including aerostructures, avionics, interiors, power and controls, and air traffic management, serving customers globally.

name: Abbott Vascular
description: Abbott Cardiovascular develops life-changing medical device technologies and solutions for cardiovascular conditions, serving healthcare professionals and patients. They offer products, therapies, education, and support for managing heart health, including electrophysiology and remote hemodynamic monitoring.

name: Sun World International
description: Sun World International is a global fruit variety development and licensing company, specializing in table grape, citrus, mango, and stone fruit varieties. They serve growers by offering industry-leading fruit genetics and managing variety rights, with a focus on sustainability and emerging technologies.

name: Gosch Toyota
description: Gosch Toyota, an automotive dealership in Hemet, California, serves the Inland Empire region by selling new and used Toyota vehicles. It provides financing options, genuine parts, and comprehensive after-sale services including maintenance, repairs, and a certified collision center.

name: Moss Brothers Auto Group
description: Moss Bros. Auto Group is a family-owned automotive dealership group operating in Riverside, San Bernardino, and Moreno Valley, California. They offer new and used car sales, vehicle service, parts, and collision repair across multiple brands like Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, Volkswagen, Honda, Toyota, Chevrolet, and GMC.

name: Paradise Chevrolet
description: Paradise Chevrolet Cadillac is a family-owned dealership in Temecula, CA, offering new and used Chevrolet and Cadillac vehicles, along with financing, parts, and award-winning service. They serve customers in Temecula, Murrieta, and surrounding areas, providing a range of automotive sales and maintenance solutions.

name: Pedder Auto Group
description: Pedder Auto Group is a family-owned and operated automotive retailer serving Southern California since 2008. They offer new, used, and certified pre-owned vehicles from brands like Nissan, Hyundai, Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, and Ram across 8 locations. Key activities include vehicle sales, service, parts, and financing.

name: California TrusFrame
description: Builders FirstSource, which California TrusFrame is part of, is the nation's largest supplier of structural building products, value-added components, and services. They serve the professional market for single-family and multi-family construction, as well as repair and remodeling, operating across 43 states with approximately 570 locations.

name: Milgard Windows & Doors
description: Milgard Windows & Doors manufactures custom, quality, and energy-efficient windows and patio doors, including vinyl, fiberglass, and aluminum options. They serve homeowners, architects, contractors, and builders for both new construction and replacement projects, aiming for trouble-free orders.

name: Vons
description: Vons is a grocery retailer offering a wide array of products including fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, pantry staples, and household items. It serves individual consumers through in-store shopping, grocery delivery, and pickup services, with a dedicated section for business customers.

name: Walmart Neighborhood Market
description: Walmart is a retail organization offering a vast array of products including groceries, electronics, clothing, home goods, and health and wellness items. It serves a broad customer base, providing various services like pharmacy, auto care, and financial services, aiming to help customers save money and live better.

name: FedEx Freight
description: FedEx Freight is North America's largest LTL carrier, providing less-than-truckload and air freight services across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. It serves diverse industries like retail and manufacturing, utilizing a vast network of over 365 service centers and nearly 30,000 vehicles, including multiple locations across California.

name: Sunline Transit Agency
description: SunLine Transit Agency provides safe, innovative, and reliable public transportation, including SunBus, SunRide, and SunDial Paratransit services, to the Coachella Valley. The agency drives the region's future of sustainable mobility and offers programs for seniors, persons with disabilities, and employers.

name: American Integrated Services
description: American Integrated Services, Inc. provides environmental remediation, industrial demolition, specialty transportation, and waste management services. They serve various industries with solutions including emergency response, oilfield support, and containment, operating across multiple regions including the Gulf Coast and California.

name: Securitas
description: Securitas is a global provider of intelligent security solutions, offering services from guarding to technology, fire and safety, and corporate risk management. They serve various industries including aviation, construction, retail, and critical infrastructure, operating in 44 markets worldwide.

name: Lloyd Pest & Termite Control
description: Lloyd Pest Control provides residential and commercial pest and termite control services, including treatments for ants, roaches, rodents, and termites. Serving homes and businesses across Southern California, including San Diego, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, and Los Angeles counties, the company has been operating since 1931.

name: Coachella Valley Unified School District
description: Coachella Valley Unified School District serves 15,817 students across 23 schools, including high schools, middle schools, elementary schools, and an adult education school. It offers 25 high school career pathway programs and 14 schools with Headstart and Preschool Programs, aiming to empower students in their communities.

name: Corona-Norco Unified School District
description: The Corona-Norco Unified School District is the 8th largest district in California, operating 53 schools and serving 49,487 students. It provides K-12 education, career technical education, and various student programs, aiming for a 96.4% graduation rate.

name: Hemet Unified School District
description: Hemet Unified School District provides educational services, enrolling students across all grade levels, including preschool. The district offers nutrition services, after-school programs, and wellness centers, serving the community in Hemet, CA.

name: Riverside City College
description: Riverside City College is an educational institution offering diverse academic programs, degrees, and certificates across eight instructional pathways, serving students in higher education.

name: Supercare Health
description: SuperCare Health provides respiratory and sleep care solutions for patients with chronic diseases, serving over 140,000 patients annually. They partner with healthcare professionals and insurance providers, offering equipment, supplies, prescriptions with home delivery, and individualized care programs across 28 service locations nationwide.

name: American Medical Response
description: American Medical Response (AMR) provides emergency and patient relocation services, including 911 emergency, advanced and basic life support, specialty care, and interfacility transportation. As part of Global Medical Response, AMR serves communities across multiple states, working with cities, counties, fire departments, and government agencies.

name: Corona Regional Medical Center
description: Corona Regional Medical Center is a healthcare provider in Corona, CA, offering a wide range of services including emergency, cardiology, orthopedics, and behavioral health. It serves the community with 69 physicians and 250 employees, focusing on patient safety and comprehensive medical care.

name: Desert Regional Medical Center
description: Desert Care Network is a healthcare resource in the Coachella Valley and Morongo Basin regions of Southern California, comprising three hospitals: Desert Regional Medical Center, JFK Memorial Hospital, and Hi-Desert Medical Center. They provide advanced healthcare services including cardiovascular, emergency room, oncology, orthopedics, women and infants, and wound care.

name: Eisenhower Medical Center
description: Eisenhower Health is a not-for-profit healthcare system providing comprehensive medical services, including a hospital, primary care, urgent care, and various specialty programs, serving the healthcare industry in Rancho Mirage, CA.

name: JFK Memorial Hospital
description: JFK Memorial Hospital, part of Desert Care Network, is a 145-bed acute-care hospital offering emergency care, cardiovascular services, orthopedics, and maternity care, operating within the healthcare industry in Indio, CA.

name: Kaiser Permanente Riverside Medical Center
description: Kaiser Permanente is an integrated managed care consortium, providing comprehensive health care services and coverage, focusing on preventive care and offering a wide range of medical specialties and wellness resources across multiple regions.

name: Menifee Valley Medical Center
description: Menifee Global Medical Center is a healthcare facility offering a full range of inpatient and outpatient services, including emergency care, orthopedic surgery, cardiology, and various specialty medical services, committed to personalized patient care.

name: Riverside University Health System
description: Riverside University Health System (RUHS) is the safety net provider for Riverside County, comprising a Medical Center, 14 Community Health Centers, and departments for Behavioral Health and Public Health. RUHS offers comprehensive medical, behavioral, and public health services, including emergency care, specialty medicine, mental health support, and preventive programs, serving residents across the county.

name: ProMedica Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation
description: ProMedica is a mission-driven healthcare organization providing a wide range of clinical care, including hospitals, doctors, and various specialized services, focused on improving health and well-being in communities.

name: Castle Park
description: Castle Park is a family-fun entertainment center in Riverside, California, offering over 20 rides, four mini-golf courses, an arcade, and a seasonal water playground called Buccaneer Cove. It serves guests of all ages with attractions and hosts special events and group gatherings.

name: Eldorado Country Club
description: Eldorado Country Club, a private member-owned club in Indian Wells, California, offers premier golf on an 18-hole course, fine dining, and extensive recreational amenities including a new spa and fitness complex. Serving a discerning, invitation-only membership, it operates with 51-100 employees, providing luxury and social experiences.

name: Mission Hills Country Club
description: Mission Hills Country Club in Rancho Mirage, California, offers championship golf on three courses, racquet sports, a fitness center, and spa services. It provides private dining, club life activities, and hosts events like weddings and corporate meetings, serving members and guests in the Inland Empire/Desert region.

name: Oak Grove Center
description: Oak Grove Center is a nonprofit organization supporting at-risk children and families through education, healing, and community-based care. They offer residential treatment, day programs, special education, and mental health services for ages 5-22, including an Arts Program.

name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel
description: Hilton operates a global portfolio of hotels and resorts, including the DoubleTree by Hilton brand, offering diverse accommodations for leisure and business travelers. They provide various stay experiences, from beach getaways to city adventures, across destinations like the United States, Mexico, Japan, and China.

name: Hyatt Regency Indian Wells Resort & Spa
description: Hyatt Hotels and Resorts operates a global portfolio of diverse hotel brands, including Hyatt Regency, offering luxury, lifestyle, and essential accommodations, along with meeting and event services, within the hospitality industry.

name: Marriott's Shadow Ridge II
description: Marriott International, Inc. is a global hospitality company offering a diverse portfolio of hotel brands, vacation home rentals, and all-inclusive resorts. It serves travelers worldwide with accommodations, dining, fitness, and meeting experiences, catering to various stay types from luxury to extended stays.

It focuses on developing creative and critical thinkers, offering curriculum in subjects like literacy, mathematics, and science, alongside specialized services and community engagement.

name: Castilleja School
description: Castilleja School is an independent school in Palo Alto, California, dedicated to educating motivated young women from diverse backgrounds. Established in 1907, it focuses on developing confident thinkers and compassionate leaders through academic programs, arts, and athletics, preparing them to effect change in the world.

name: Community School of Music and Arts
description: The Community School of Music and Arts (CSMA) is Northern California's largest nonprofit provider of arts education, inspiring creativity in people of all ages and skill levels. It serves nearly 30,000 people annually through on-site and off-site music and art programs, including classes, private lessons, and community initiatives.

name: Cupertino Union School District
description: The Cupertino Union School District provides education for Transitional Kindergarten through 8th-grade students across 23 schools in the Bay Area region of California. It focuses on relevant, rigorous instruction and personalized learning, offering various programs including special education and language immersion.

name: Duveneck Elementary School
description: Duveneck Elementary School provides K-5 education in Palo Alto, California, focusing on curriculum standards, social-emotional learning, and student wellness. It serves elementary school-aged children in the Bay Area, offering various school life activities and learning resources.

name: Escuela Popular Family Learning
description: Escuela Popular Family Learning is a San Jose-based family learning center established in 1986. It offers educational services, including a Childcare Academy, K-8 Dual Language Academy, and High School Academies for students under and over 19, focusing on bilingual and biliterate development.

name: Gilroy High School
description: Gilroy High School is a public high school in Gilroy, California, serving approximately 1,664 students in grades 9-12. It provides comprehensive academic, fine arts, and career technical education, including specialized programs like Biomedical Science Academy, to prepare students for college and careers.

name: Gunn High School
description: Henry M. Gunn High School is a public high school in Palo Alto, California, serving students with academic programs including Career Technical Education, AP courses, and special education. It focuses on fostering self-reliant learners who contribute to their communities.

name: Harker School
description: The Harker School is a private K-12 educational institution in San Jose, CA, offering comprehensive academic programs, athletics, and arts for lower, middle, and upper school students. It serves students from transitional kindergarten through high school, focusing on character development, global education, and college preparation.

name: Mission College
description: Mission College is Silicon Valley's community college, offering academic programs, transfer assistance, and career guidance. It serves a diverse student body with free tuition for those in its service area, along with support like free childcare, meals, and healthcare. Key activities include providing education in various fields and fostering student success.

name: San Jose City College
description: San Jose City College provides diverse academic programs, degrees, and certificates, preparing students for university transfer or direct workforce entry. Serving the Bay Area, it offers career education, student support, and pathways in fields like STEM, healthcare, and business, fostering student success and community development.

name: San Jose State University
description: San José State University provides world-class education, offering diverse majors and programs, including online bachelor's degrees, and conducts research and innovation. It serves a broad student body, preparing them for the job market, and is recognized as a top university in the nation for programming and software engineering talent.

name: Stanford Law School
description: Stanford Law School provides rigorous academics and immersive experiences, shaping law and policy through leading-edge research in areas like constitutional law, privacy rights, and AI's impact on law. It serves future and current students through JD, joint, and advanced degree programs, and engages with faculty, alumni, and the broader legal community.

name: Stanford University School of Education
description: Stanford Graduate School of Education is dedicated to solving education's greatest challenges through rigorous research, model training programs, and partnerships with educators worldwide. It offers undergraduate, MA, PhD, and professional learning programs, pursuing equitable, accessible, and effective learning for all.

name: Stanford University School of Medicine
description: A medical school offering education and research in medicine.

name: Children's Health Council
description: Children's Health Council (CHC) is a Bay Area healthcare leader providing mental health and learning difference support for children, teens, and young adults (ages 0-25) and their families. CHC offers evaluations, therapy, psychiatry, and specialized learning support, operating two specialized schools and various programs across multiple locations in California.

name: Waverley Surgery Center
description: Waverley Surgery Center in Palo Alto, CA, provides exceptional, personalized same-day outpatient surgical care across various specialties. Recognized as a top ambulatory surgery center by U.S. News & World Report and Newsweek, it serves patients seeking accessible and affordable treatment and recovery.

name: Ariosa Diagnostics
description: A diagnostics company focused on prenatal testing.

name: Guardant Health
description: A company specializing in precision oncology diagnostics.

name: Omnivision Technologies
description: A company developing advanced digital imaging solutions.
swp_sectors: Information and Communication Technologies - Digital Media

name: Accentcare Personal Care
description: AccentCare provides post-acute and in-home care services, including personal care, home health, palliative care, and hospice. They serve patients by delivering personalized care to manage daily tasks, chronic conditions, recovery, or end-of-life stages. AccentCare partners with over 70 health systems, physician groups, and payors.

name: Home Instead
description: Home Instead provides personalized in-home senior care services, including personal care, memory care, companion care, and 24-hour support, helping older adults live safely and independently at home. They serve families across six countries with nearly 1,200 locations, delivering 60 million hours of care annually.

name: Homecare California
description: Homecare California delivers licensed in-home senior care, offering hourly, 24-hour, and live-in services across the Bay Area. Key activities include personal care, companionship, and specialized support for conditions like Alzheimer's, serving seniors in counties such as Santa Clara, San Mateo, Alameda, and Contra Costa.

name: Seniors At Home
description: Seniors At Home, a division of JFCS, provides a comprehensive continuum of in-home care, dementia care, and support services for aging adults and their families across the Bay Area, California. They offer personalized care plans to help seniors live independently.

name: Visiting Angels Senior Home Care
description: Visiting Angels provides non-medical in-home senior care services, including companion care, personal care, and specialized support for conditions like Alzheimer's and dementia. Serving thousands across the country since 1998, they offer flexible, customized care plans to help seniors age safely and independently in their own homes.

name: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan
description: Kaiser Permanente offers custom care and coverage, providing health plans, doctors, and hospitals across regions including Northern and Southern California, Colorado, Georgia, Hawaii, Maryland, Virginia, Washington D.C., Oregon, and SW Washington. They focus on preventive care, offering services like telehealth, pharmacy, and health and wellness resources to members and communities.

name: Momentum for Mental Health
description: Momentum for Health provides complete, personalized behavioral health care for adults in Santa Clara County, California. They offer outpatient, residential, supportive services, and community programs, aiming to help individuals achieve mental and emotional health and participate fully in life. The organization is licensed and CARF accredited.

name: Stanford Blood Center
description: Stanford Blood Center collects whole blood, platelets, plasma, and SuperRed donations to support patients. Operating multiple donation centers across the Bay Area and hosting mobile drives, they also advance transfusion and transplantation medicine through research and specialized products and services.

name: Crestwood Behavioral Health
description: Crestwood Behavioral Health provides comprehensive behavioral healthcare services across 31 California campuses, including Bay Area locations like San Mateo, San Francisco, San Jose, and Fremont. They offer psychiatric, recovery, and rehabilitation programs for adults with mental health challenges, focusing on community reintegration, wellness, and skill development.

name: El Camino Health Los Gatos Hospital
description: El Camino Health Los Gatos Hospital is a 143-bed acute care facility serving Los Gatos and surrounding Bay Area communities. It provides comprehensive services including emergency, mother-baby, heart, cancer, orthopedic, and behavioral health care, along with various clinics and rehabilitation.

name: Good Samaritan Hospital
description: Good Samaritan Hospital is a comprehensive medical and surgical facility in San Jose, California, offering 24/7 emergency care, advanced imaging, labor and delivery, and physical rehabilitation. It provides a wide range of specialty services, including cardiology, oncology, orthopedics, and women's care, serving the San Jose community with compassionate, patient-focused healthcare.

name: O'Connor Hospital
description: O'Connor Hospital is a 358-bed acute care facility in San Jose, California, providing a full range of inpatient and outpatient medical, surgical, and specialty programs, including cancer, cardiology, and emergency services. It serves over 1 million residents of Santa Clara County and is part of the Santa Clara Valley Healthcare system.

name: Palo Alto VA Medical Center
description: The VA Palo Alto Health Care System provides comprehensive health care services to Veterans, their families, and caregivers across multiple locations including Palo Alto, Menlo Park, and Livermore. Key activities include managing appointments, prescriptions, medical records, and pioneering treatments like the first transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement in the VHA.

name: Regional Medical Center San Jose
description: Regional Medical Center San Jose is a 265-bed general acute care hospital and Level II trauma center in East San Jose, part of Santa Clara Valley Healthcare. It provides comprehensive inpatient and outpatient services, including emergency, cardiovascular, neurosciences, orthopedics, and medical/surgical care, serving residents across Santa Clara County.

name: Alum Rock Counseling Center
description: Alum Rock Counseling Center heals families and inspires youth to reach their full potential by providing programs for parents, at-risk youth, and crisis counseling. They serve all of Santa Clara County, focusing on behavioral health, substance use, mental health challenges, and violence prevention.

name: Manor Care
description: Manor Care, now a subsidiary of ProMedica, provides skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and senior living services. It serves aged individuals, including those with Alzheimer's disease, offering short-term and long-term care, various therapies, and assisted living options across facilities in California, such as Sunnyvale and Walnut Creek, and nationwide.

name: Promedica Skilled Nurse-Rehab
description: ProMedica Skilled Nursing and Rehabilitation (Rossmoor) in Walnut Creek, California, offers nursing care and rehabilitation services for seniors. As part of the larger ProMedica network, it provides short-term and long-term skilled nursing, and memory care in an inpatient setting.

name: VITAS Healthcare
description: VITAS Healthcare is a national leader in hospice, palliative, and end-of-life care, serving patients and families across 15 states and the District of Columbia. With over 12,000 professionals since 1978, they provide comprehensive services including home care, inpatient care, and emotional support.

name: Forum At Rancho San Antonio
description: The Forum at Rancho San Antonio is a non-profit, resident-owned Life Plan Community in Cupertino, CA, offering independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and memory care for seniors. It provides a continuum of care with 76 licensed skilled nursing beds, focusing on high-quality, resort-style living and comprehensive healthcare services.

name: Lytton Gardens
description: Lytton Gardens, part of CARING Housing Ministries, provides housing and a sense of community for seniors in Palo Alto, California. It operates multiple locations, including Lytton Gardens, Lytton Gardens II, and Lytton Gardens IV, focusing on creating comfortable living environments for its residents.

name: Moldaw Family Residences
description: Moldaw Family Residences is a non-profit Life Plan Community in Palo Alto, California, offering independent living, assisted living, and memory care for Bay Area seniors. It provides comprehensive healthcare, rehabilitation, and a vibrant, multigenerational lifestyle on an 8.5-acre campus.

name: Sunny View Retirement Community
description: Sunny View Retirement Community, a Front Porch Community in Cupertino, CA, offers a continuum of senior living care, including independent living, assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing. Serving seniors in the Silicon Valley region, it operates a 12-acre campus with various amenities and services to support residents' well-being.

name: Terraces At Los Altos
description: A senior living community offering independent living, assisted living, and memory care.

name: Vi At Palo Alto
description: Vi at Palo Alto is a luxury Life Plan Community providing stylish apartments, world-class cuisine, and varied lifestyle programming. It offers a continuum of care, including skilled nursing, assisted living, and memory support, serving seniors in the Bay Area.

name: Apjcc Silicon Valley
description: Apjcc Silicon Valley, a programming division of Jewish Silicon Valley, is a Los Gatos community center serving the Jewish and general community. It offers extensive social, cultural, educational, recreational, health, and wellness programs for all ages, including preschool, fitness, aquatics, and camps.

name: Community Solutions
description: An organization providing social services and support to the community.

name: East Valley Family YMCA
description: The YMCA of Silicon Valley is a nonprofit dedicated to youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, serving the Bay Area from Redwood City to Morgan Hill. It offers programs like personal training, swim lessons, child care, camps, and youth/adult sports, fostering community and empowering individuals to live healthier lives.

name: Pacific Clinics
description: Pacific Clinics is California's leading behavioral health provider, delivering high-quality behavioral health and social services to children, adults, and families across Los Angeles, Orange, Ventura, Bay Area, Capital, Central, and Inland Empire regions. They offer services including mental health care, substance use disorder treatment, educational programs like Head Start, and support services such as housing and career assistance.

name: Trumpet Behavioral Health
description: Trumpet Behavioral Health, a division of BlueSprig, provides compassionate and comprehensive Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy services to children with autism across the United States. They specialize in early childhood development and offer individualized care in center-based, home-based, community-based, virtual, and school-based settings.

name: Palo Alto Community Child Care
description: Palo Alto Community Child Care (PACCC) provides and advocates for exceptional and accessible childhood education and care, serving infants, toddlers, preschoolers, and school-aged children through various centers and programs including afterschool and summer camps.

name: California's Great America
description: California's Great America is an amusement park in the San Francisco Bay Area, offering over 50 rides, thrill rides, roller coasters, and the South Bay Shores waterpark. It serves families and thrill-seekers, providing entertainment, dining, and group activities.

name: Gilroy Gardens Family Theme Park
description: Gilroy Gardens Family Theme Park is a 501(c)(3) non-profit educational institution providing family entertainment with rides, water attractions, and six majestic gardens, including the world-famous Circus Trees. It serves families and groups, offering educational programs on nature and horticulture, plus year-round events.

name: Bay Club
description: Bay Club operates over 25 membership-based sports and active lifestyle clubs across California, Oregon, and Washington, serving over 135,000 individuals and families. It offers diverse amenities including fitness, tennis, golf, pickleball, aquatics, dining, and spa services, fostering community and well-being.

name: Bowlero San Jose
description: Lucky Strike San Jose is an entertainment center offering 59 high-tech bowling lanes, an arcade, and a lounge area. It serves individuals and groups of all ages, hosting kids' parties, corporate events, and bowling leagues. Key activities include bowling, arcade games, and food and beverage services.

name: Cinnabar Hills Golf Club
description: Cinnabar Hills Golf Club is a public golf course in San Jose, California, offering 27 holes designed by John Harbottle III. It provides championship-caliber golf with scenic views, dining at The Grille, and hosts weddings and special events for up to 200 people. The club also features the Lee Brandenburg Historical Golf Museum.

name: Equinox Palo Alto
description: Equinox is a luxury fitness club offering unlimited signature classes, personal training, Pilates, and spa services. It provides exclusive amenities and award-winning spaces for high-performance fitness experiences, also extending services through the Equinox+ app for on-demand classes.

name: Cordevalle
description: CordeValle is a luxury resort nestled in the Santa Cruz Mountains of Northern California, offering world-class golf, a spa, gourmet dining, and a winery. It serves guests seeking relaxation and extraordinary experiences, providing accommodations, event spaces, and various activities across its 1,700-acre sanctuary.

name: Embassy Suites By Hilton
description: Embassy Suites by Hilton provides spacious two-room suite accommodations for leisure and business travelers across the US, Canada, Middle East, Caribbean, and South America. Key offerings include complimentary made-to-order breakfast, evening receptions, fitness centers, and meeting/event spaces, serving guests seeking comfortable stays with added amenities.

name: Hotel Valencia Santana Row
description: Hotel Valencia Santana Row is a luxury boutique hotel in San Jose, California, offering sophisticated accommodations, dining at Oveja Negra, Vbar, and Cielo, and event spaces for meetings and weddings. It serves leisure and business travelers seeking a high-end experience in the Santana Row entertainment district.

name: Nobu Hotel Palo Alto
description: Nobu Hotel Palo Alto is a luxury hotel in Silicon Valley offering guest rooms, suites, and Ryokan accommodations. It provides renowned hospitality, iconic cuisine from Chef Nobu Matsuhisa, wellness facilities, and event spaces, serving guests seeking a luxurious urban oasis in Palo Alto.

name: Sheraton San Jose Hotel
description: A hotel offering accommodation, dining, and meeting facilities.

name: Signia By Hilton San Jose
description: Signia by Hilton San Jose is an AAA Four Diamond luxury hotel in downtown San Jose, offering 500+ rooms and over 55,000 sq. ft. of meeting space. It serves business and leisure travelers with diverse dining, a rooftop pool, and fitness facilities, operating as a key hospitality hub in Silicon Valley.

name: Sonesta San Jose-Milpitas
description: Sonesta Silicon Valley is a hotel in Milpitas, California, offering accommodations, dining at Manzanita restaurant, and event spaces for meetings, weddings, and sports groups. It serves business and leisure travelers, including those visiting nearby tech companies and attractions.

name: The Westin Palo Alto
description: The Westin Palo Alto is a four-star hotel in downtown Palo Alto, offering 184 luxurious rooms, dining at Café Soleil, and event venues. It serves leisure and business travelers visiting Stanford University and Silicon Valley, providing lodging, food service, and wellness amenities like a heated pool.

name: Le Boulanger
description: Le Boulanger is a family-owned and operated bakery serving Northern California since 1922, specializing in a wide range of bread products, including bagels, baguettes, croissants, and muffins. They serve various buying groups and sales channels, including caterers, delis, grocery stores, healthcare facilities, hotels, restaurants, and sports venues.

name: Lee's Sandwiches International
description: Lee's Sandwiches International, Inc. is a family-founded food service company that began in San Jose, CA in 1980, offering a diverse menu including Asian and Euro sandwiches, breakfast items, pastries, and coffee. It serves customers through its stores and catering services.

name: Steins Beer Garden
description: Steins Beer Garden in Mountain View, CA, offers 31 beers on tap, craft cocktails, and scratch-made New American Cuisine. It serves customers daily for lunch and dinner, providing dine-in, private events, catering, and online ordering for pick-up and delivery services.

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Neighborhood Grill + Bar operates as a casual dining restaurant chain, serving customers with a variety of appetizers, entrees, and beverages for dine-in, takeout, and delivery. They offer catering services and gift cards, with locations across various neighborhoods.

name: Black Angus Steakhouse
description: Black Angus Steakhouse, established in 1964, is an American steakhouse that specializes in flame-grilled, aged steaks. It serves customers seeking a dining experience with various menu options, including seasonal specials and a Campfire Feast. The organization operates with a focus on quality and customer rewards through its Prime Club.

name: Chuck E. Cheese
description: Chuck E. Cheese is a family entertainment center chain offering arcade games, pizza, and birthday party packages for kids. Operated by CEC Entertainment, it serves families with children across the United States and internationally, providing a venue for fun and celebrations.

name: Enoteca La Storia
description: Enoteca La Storia is an international wine bar, Italian eatery, and neighborhood bottle shop collective established in 2010, serving the Bay Area. They offer award-winning wine experiences, a global wine club, and authentic Italian cuisine, operating across multiple locations including Ancora Vino shops.

name: The Grill on the Alley
description: The Grill on the Alley is a steak house in San Jose, CA, offering a menu of food and beverages. It serves customers in the Bay Area region through dine-in, takeout, and catering services, including private dining options.

name: Il Fornaio
description: Il Fornaio operates authentic Italian restaurants across the US, including multiple locations in California's Bay Area. They offer dining, catering for events of any size, private dining experiences, and online ordering, aiming to provide an authentic Italian experience to their guests.

name: Old Spaghetti Factory
description: The Old Spaghetti Factory is a family-friendly Italian restaurant established in 1969, offering a unique dining experience with antique decor and a menu featuring classic Italian dishes and their signature Mizithra cheese. They serve families and groups, providing dine-in, banquets, and catering services.

name: Pacific Catch
description: Pacific Catch is a California-born seafood restaurant serving fresh, sustainably sourced, and ocean-friendly seafood inspired by the Pacific. It operates across multiple locations in California, offering dine-in, catering, and online ordering, with a focus on a feel-good dining experience.

name: PF Chang's
description: P.F. Chang's is a restaurant chain offering handcrafted Asian-inspired food for dine-in, to-go, and catering. They serve individual customers with lunch specials, dinner, and beverages, including a limited-time seasonal menu. Key activities include restaurant operations, reservations, and a rewards program.

name: Autonation BMW of Mountain View
description: AutoNation BMW of Mountain View is a Bay Area dealership selling new and pre-owned BMW vehicles, offering financing, and buying used cars. As part of America's largest automotive retailer, it provides comprehensive maintenance and repair services to customers in the Mountain View, Cupertino, Palo Alto, and San Jose areas.

name: Autonation Mercedes-Benz
description: AutoNation Mercedes-Benz of Stevens Creek is a San Jose-based dealership selling new and used Mercedes-Benz vehicles, offering leasing, financing, and comprehensive service, maintenance, and collision repair. Serving the Bay Area, it provides parts and expert automotive care to customers.

name: Almaden Valley Athletic Club
description: Almaden Valley Athletic Club (AVAC) is a family fitness facility in San Jose, California, offering comprehensive health and wellness programs for all ages. Its five-acre campus features indoor/outdoor fitness, pools, tennis, and a swim school, serving the Bay Area community with classes, training, and childcare.

name: Watercourse Way Bath House Spa
description: Watercourse Way Bath House Spa offers private hot tub rooms, various massages including Swedish and deep tissue, and spa treatments like mud wraps and salt glows. They also provide organic facials and waxing services, serving individuals seeking relaxation and therapeutic experiences in Palo Alto, CA.

name: Santa Clara County Department of Environmental Protection
description: The Santa Clara County Department of Environmental Health safeguards community health by enforcing regulations and conducting inspections across Santa Clara County. It addresses air and water quality, food safety, waste management, hazardous materials, and vector control, serving residents and businesses.

name: Santa Clara County Public Defender
description: The Santa Clara County Public Defender provides legal representation for indigent clients in criminal defense cases, including misdemeanors, adult felonies, juvenile justice, and mental health cases. They also offer record clearance and post-conviction services, operating across multiple offices in Santa Clara County.

name: San Jose Police Department
description: The San Jose Police Department provides public safety services to the diverse community of San Jose, California, through community partnerships and 21st Century Policing practices. They ensure equity, protect rights, and offer equal protection under the law, handling crime reporting, investigations, traffic enforcement, and community engagement.

name: Santa Clara County District Attorney
description: The Santa Clara County District Attorney's Office prosecutes criminal cases, provides victim services, and handles consumer protection for Santa Clara County, California. They work to ensure justice, support victims, and address issues like real estate fraud and truancy, serving the community of Silicon Valley.

name: San Jose Environmental Enforcement
description: The City of San José Environmental Services Department provides essential utility services including recycling, garbage, wastewater treatment, drinking water, stormwater protection, and recycled water. It serves residents and businesses in San José, focusing on environmental sustainability and public health through various programs and enforcement.

name: Coke Farm
description: Coke Farm, established in 1981, is a 100% organic grower/shipper/handler and food hub in San Juan Bautista, California. It supports over 100 organic growers in the region, offering seasonal and year-round organic produce, including eco-friendly packaged strawberries, to customers both locally and nationally.

name: Trical Inc.
description: TriCal Inc. provides soil fumigation products and solutions, including TriClor, to prevent soil-borne diseases and optimize harvest yields. They serve growers of various crops like strawberries, tree fruit, nuts, and grapes, focusing on healthy fields and sustainable practices.

name: San Benito Foods
description: San Benito Foods, located in Hollister, California, is a century-old manufacturer and co-packer of traditional and organic canned tomato products. They serve foodservice distributors and private label customers nationwide, processing fresh California tomatoes into over 100 different items, employing up to 500 during peak season.

name: Alpha Teknova
description: Alpha Teknova manufactures high-quality reagents, including buffers, media, and water, for the life sciences industry. They serve over 3,000 customers in academia, biotechnology, and biopharmaceuticals, offering both off-the-shelf and custom formulations from discovery through commercialization in their 180,000 sq ft ISO 13485 certified facilities.

name: Armstrong Growers
description: Armstrong Growers is an employee-owned wholesale grower serving Independent Garden Centers, resorts, commercial properties, and landscape maintenance companies across California and the Southwest. They produce a wide selection of plants, including color, houseplants, succulents, and roses, with a focus on high-quality indoor tropical houseplants.

name: Hokto Kinoko
description: Hokto Kinoko is an agriculture company specializing in the research, development, and sustainable cultivation of organic mushrooms, including varieties like Eryngii and Maitake. Its San Marcos, California facility produces approximately six million pounds of mushrooms annually, serving consumers and chefs with healthy, flavorful fungi.

name: Hollandia Dairy
description: Hollandia Dairy is a family-run farm that has supplied fresh, high-quality, Certified Humane dairy products to customers across California for over 70 years. They are committed to the health of their customers, community, and cows, offering products from cows not treated with rBST.

name: Henry Avocado Corporation
description: Henry Avocado Corporation, founded in 1925, is a family-owned company providing year-round conventional and organic avocados from California, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, and Chile. They offer custom-ripened avocados and serve retail and foodservice markets through seven regional distribution centers.

name: Sempra
description: Sempra is a San Diego-based North American energy infrastructure company serving nearly 40 million consumers. It operates regulated electric and natural gas utilities, including SDG&E and SoCalGas in California, and develops LNG export facilities, pipelines, and clean energy projects across the U.S. and Mexico.

name: Otay Water District
description: The Otay Water District is a public agency providing water, recycled water, and sewer services to over 240,000 customers across 125 square miles of southeastern San Diego County, California. Key activities include acquiring, treating, and distributing water, alongside operating sewer facilities and promoting water conservation.

name: Vallecitos Water District
description: The Vallecitos Water District provides water and wastewater services, including water operations, quality, and conservation programs, to customers in the San Diego / Imperial region of California. They also manage engineering, customer service, and offer resources like rebates and educational programs.

name: Vista Irrigation District
description: Vista Irrigation District supplies high-quality water to its customers in an economically and environmentally responsible way. Serving the San Diego / Imperial region of California, the district manages water treatment, conservation programs, and customer services like billing and rebates.

name: Balfour Beatty Construction
description: Balfour Beatty Construction is a company engaged in large-scale construction projects.

name: Brandsafway Services
description: Brandsafway Services offers specialized services such as scaffolding, insulation, and access solutions for industrial and commercial clients.

name: Bycor General Contractors
description: Bycor General Contractors is a San Diego-based commercial construction company, established in 1981, serving Southern California. They partner with architects, developers, and property owners across sectors like healthcare, life sciences, retail, and education, offering comprehensive preconstruction and construction services.

name: Noah Homes
description: Noah Homes is a nonprofit organization in San Diego County, California, providing exceptional residential care and choices for 90 adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Established in 1983, it operates 10 homes on an 11-acre property, focusing on lifelong independence and community integration through various programs and advocacy efforts.

name: Solpac Construction
description: Soltek Pacific Construction, established in 1974, is a premier building prime contractor with over 52 years of experience and 1000+ completed projects. They design and build diverse structures, including educational, industrial, military, and healthcare facilities, primarily serving the San Diego region.

name: TC Construction
description: TC Construction Co., Inc. is a general engineering and design-build contractor in Southern California, specializing in underground utility infrastructure, mechanical facilities, roadway, and site preparation. Serving public and private sectors, including municipalities and homebuilders, they operate primarily in San Diego, Imperial, and Riverside Counties, employing over 200 people.

name: Hamann
description: Hamann Companies is a construction and property management firm operating in San Diego and Riverside Counties since 1954. They specialize in new construction, tenant improvements, land development, solar, and electrical services, having built over 50,000,000 square feet of projects and managing millions of square feet of commercial/industrial properties across Southern California.

name: Mcmahon Steel
description: McMahon Steel is a family-owned, mid-sized structural steel fabricator and erector based in Chula Vista, CA, serving Southern California and the Southwest. They specialize in detailing, fabricating, and installing structural and miscellaneous steel for commercial and industrial construction projects, with 100-249 employees.

name: Semper Solaris
description: Semper Solaris is a veteran-owned contractor in California, specializing in solar panel installation, battery storage, roofing, HVAC, and window replacement. They serve homeowners by providing energy-efficient home upgrades and aim to reduce energy bills and promote energy independence.

name: TB Penick & Sons
description: T.B. Penick & Sons is a San Diego-based general contractor with over 111 years of experience, specializing in general construction, structural concrete, and innovative decorative concrete systems. Serving commercial, public, and residential clients nationwide and internationally, they employ over 400 people.

name: AO Reed
description: A.O. Reed & Co. is a commercial HVAC and plumbing contractor operating in Southern California since 1914, with three offices and fabrication shops. Generating $350 million in annual revenue, they specialize in pre-construction, construction, service, and process piping for hospitals, universities, and laboratories, including LEED-rated projects.

name: Baker Electric
description: Baker Electric, established in 1938, is a 100% employee-owned electrical contractor and renewable energy provider. They offer full-service electrical construction, commercial and utility-scale solar, battery energy storage, and EV charging solutions. Serving California, Arizona, Nevada, and Montana, they cater to diverse sectors including public works, commercial, healthcare, and education.

name: Bergelectric Corporation
description: Bergelectric Corporation is a national electrical contractor specializing in electrical contracting, prefabrication, and preconstruction services. They serve diverse markets including healthcare, commercial, industrial, and higher education, with locations across California and other states.

name: Bill Howe Plumbing Heating & Air
description: Bill Howe Plumbing Heating & Air is a family-owned and operated company serving San Diego County since 1980. They provide 24/7 residential and commercial plumbing, HVAC, and restoration services, including emergency repairs, drain cleaning, AC installation, heating, and water damage restoration.

name: Itron Networked Solutions
description: Itron Networked Solutions provides smart energy and water solutions to over 8,000 utilities and cities in more than 100 countries. They modernize critical infrastructure through communication networks, metering, and data management, addressing challenges like aging infrastructure, decarbonization, and grid reliability.

name: Otis Elevator
description: Otis Elevator is a global leader in manufacturing, installing, servicing, and modernizing elevators, escalators, lifts, and moving walks. They serve residential, retail, office, hospital, hotel, and infrastructure industries, moving 2.5 billion people daily and maintaining approximately 2.5 million customer units worldwide.

name: Pacific Rim Mechanical
description: Pacific Rim Mechanical is a mechanical construction firm providing comprehensive mechanical contracting and facility services, including HVAC, plumbing, design, and engineering. Serving diverse industries across Southern California, it offers customized solutions for construction, maintenance, and repair.

name: Same Day Heating Cooling & Plumbing
description: Same Day Heating Cooling & Plumbing provides emergency and routine services for HVAC and plumbing systems.

name: Thyssenkrupp Elevator
