description: Graybill Medical Group is one of the region's largest independent primary and specialty care medical groups, providing quality healthcare to multiple generations of families. With over 80 physicians, they offer urgent, primary, and specialty care across offices in Oceanside, Vista, San Marcos, Escondido, Fallbrook, Murrieta, and Temecula.

name: Indian Health Council
description: Indian Health Council provides compassionate, integrated healthcare, including medical, dental, behavioral health, and pharmacy services, to nine consortium tribes in San Diego's North County Region. Established in 1970, it is accredited by AAAHC and funded by Indian Health Service and NIH.

name: Naval Medical Center San Diego
description: Naval Medical Center San Diego provides comprehensive healthcare services, including primary, specialty, hospital, and emergency care, to military personnel and their families. It also focuses on medical education and research, serving the San Diego region.

name: Scripps Clinic
description: Scripps Clinic, part of the non-profit Scripps Health system, provides comprehensive primary and specialty medical and surgical services to San Diegans. With over 900 providers across 30+ outpatient centers, it offers clinical care, research, and medical education, serving over 600,000 patients annually.

name: Sharp Rees-Stealy Chula Vista
description: Sharp Rees-Stealy Chula Vista is a medical group in Chula Vista, California, offering primary care, urgent care, and various specialties including cardiology, endocrinology, and orthopedics. It serves residents in Chula Vista, Bonita, Eastlake, Otay Ranch, and surrounding South Bay communities of San Diego, providing both in-person and virtual appointments.

name: Shiley Eye Center at UC San Diego
description: The Shiley Eye Institute at UC San Diego provides comprehensive clinical care for eye disorders, conducts cutting-edge research on treatments and surgical techniques, and offers education in ophthalmology. It serves patients with various eye conditions, including cataracts, glaucoma, and retinal diseases, and engages in community outreach.

name: Vista Community Clinic
description: Vista Community Clinic provides low-cost, high-quality healthcare services, including family medicine, pediatrics, women's health, dental, and behavioral health. They operate twelve clinics and offer mobile care across North County San Diego, Riverside County, and Orange County, serving diverse communities with comprehensive medical care.

name: Scripps Clinic Urgent Care
description: Scripps Clinic Urgent Care provides accessible medical evaluation and treatment for minor illnesses and conditions to children and adults in San Diego County. Operating from three locations, including a 24-hour facility in La Jolla, they treat issues like sprains, fevers, and abdominal pain on a walk-in basis.

name: Genoptix Medical Laboratory
description: A medical laboratory specializing in genetic testing.

name: Imaging Healthcare Specialists
description: Imaging Healthcare Specialists provides high-quality diagnostic imaging services, including MRI, CT, and Mammography, utilizing advanced technology and AI-assisted diagnostics. They serve patients across Southern California and San Diego County with multiple convenient locations.

name: Accent Care
description: AccentCare provides exceptional post-acute and in-home care, including personal care, home health, palliative care, and hospice services. They serve patients by delivering high-quality, personalized care to help manage daily tasks, chronic conditions, recovery, or end-of-life stages. AccentCare partners with health systems, physician groups, and payors, with a presence in San Diego, California.

name: All Heart Home Care San Diego CA
description: All Heart Home Care San Diego CA provides personalized, non-medical in-home care to older adults and veterans across San Diego County. Services include daily task assistance, personal care, meal support, and specialized care like Alzheimer's and hospice, delivered by compassionate, trained caregivers.

name: Sharp Home Health and Medical Care
description: Sharp Home Infusion Services provides high-quality, safe, and coordinated home infusion care across San Diego County. They offer intravenous antibiotic therapy, chemotherapy, skilled nursing, and nutritional support, serving patients with chronic illnesses or complex infections, and are accredited by The Joint Commission.

name: Gameday Men's Health
description: A health clinic specializing in men's health services.

name: San Diego Blood Bank
description: San Diego Blood Bank is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, also operating as Southern California Blood Bank, that collects blood donations. It serves hospitals in San Diego, Los Angeles, and Orange Counties, providing life-saving blood products and supporting research. Key activities include blood drives, financial giving, and volunteer opportunities.

name: San Diego County Children's Services
description: San Diego County Children's Services, part of the Health & Human Services Agency, works to protect, serve, and enrich the lives of children in the San Diego region. Key activities include providing child care services, child support, and promoting child and family well-being through various programs and partnerships.

name: Scripps Clinic Medical Laboratories
description: Scripps Clinic Medical Laboratories provides comprehensive diagnostic testing, including blood draws and sample collection, for Scripps inpatients, outpatients, and outreach clients across San Diego County. They operate a central lab, five hospital labs, two rapid response labs, and 19 patient service centers, supporting clinical care and research.

name: Sharp Rees-Stealy Medical Group
description: Sharp Rees-Stealy Medical Group is a comprehensive medical group in San Diego County, providing integrated and coordinated care to generations of San Diegans for over a century. With 16 convenient locations, they offer primary care, various specialties, radiology, laboratory, pharmacy, optical, and urgent care services.

name: Truecare
description: TrueCare operates 27 health centers and WIC locations across San Diego and Riverside, California, providing comprehensive wellness and specialty care. Services include primary care, pediatrics, women's health, dental, behavioral health, and mobile wellness, aiming to deliver timely, affordable, and expert healthcare to the community.

name: Alvarado Parkway Institute
description: Alvarado Parkway Institute provides personalized behavioral healthcare services, specializing in inpatient and outpatient treatment for mental health, substance use disorders, and dual diagnoses. They serve the San Diego community and beyond from locations in La Mesa, El Cajon, and San Diego.

name: Jennifer Moreno Department of Veterans Affairs
description: The Jennifer Moreno Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center in San Diego provides comprehensive healthcare services to Veterans, their families, and caregivers. Key activities include managing appointments, refilling prescriptions, mental health care, and offering various health services across multiple locations.

name: Kindred Hospital San Diego
description: Kindred Hospital San Diego is a 70-bed long-term acute care facility providing specialized, compassionate care for medically complex patients. It offers 24/7 physician and respiratory therapy access, with services including respiratory, wound, infectious disease, brain injury, stroke, cardiac, kidney care, and comprehensive rehabilitation.

name: Paradise Valley Hospital
description: Paradise Valley Hospital, a community hospital in San Diego's South Bay, has provided healthcare services for over 115 years. It offers emergency care, behavioral health, and rehabilitation services, serving patients with a focus on safety and compassionate care. The hospital is part of Prime Healthcare and has received numerous patient safety awards.

name: Scripps Green Hospital
description: Scripps Health is a not-for-profit, integrated health system in San Diego, California, serving the region with over 70 locations, including five hospital campuses and nearly 30 clinics. It offers a wide range of medical services, from primary care to specialized treatments like cancer and heart care, provided by over 3,500 affiliated physicians.

name: Scripps Memorial Hospital La Jolla
description: Scripps Memorial Hospital La Jolla is a premier general acute care hospital in San Diego, providing comprehensive clinical and surgical services, including trauma, cancer, and women's health, to the greater San Diego community. It operates with 577 licensed beds and offers clinical research and medical education.

name: Scripps Mercy Hospital Chula Vista
description: Scripps Mercy Hospital Chula Vista is part of Scripps Health, a not-for-profit integrated health system in San Diego, California. It provides comprehensive medical services, including primary, cancer, heart, and orthopedic care, serving the San Diego community through its hospitals and over 70 locations with more than 3,500 affiliated doctors.

name: Select Specialty Hospital San Diego
description: Select Specialty Hospital San Diego is a 110-bed long-term acute care hospital providing critical illness recovery services. It serves patients with complex medical problems and chronic critical illness in the San Diego region, offering specialized medical and therapeutic treatments. It operates as a joint venture with UC San Diego Health and Scripps Health.

name: Sharp Grossmont Hospital
description: Sharp HealthCare is San Diego's health care leader, providing a comprehensive range of medical services including everyday care, specialties like cancer treatment and orthopedics, and urgent/emergency care. It serves the San Diego community through various hospitals and medical groups, combining medical science with compassionate care.

name: St. Paul's PACE El Cajon
description: St. Paul's PACE is a managed healthcare plan exclusively for seniors 55 and older with chronic medical conditions, enabling them to live independently at home. It provides comprehensive medical, social, and home care services, including transportation, across multiple locations in San Diego County, having served over 4,000 seniors since 2008.

name: California Protons Cancer Therapy Center
description: California Protons Cancer Therapy Center, located in San Diego, provides advanced proton radiation therapy for various cancers, including breast, prostate, pediatric, and lung cancers. The center utilizes intensity-modulated pencil beam scanning technology across five treatment rooms, serving patients globally with a focus on precise tumor targeting and sparing healthy tissues.

name: Covenant Care California
description: Covenant Care California provides skilled nursing, post-acute care, and rehabilitation services, including various therapies and wound care. Operating over 20 facilities in California and Nevada, it serves thousands of patients and residents needing continuous nursing and assisted living support.

name: Elizabeth Hospice
description: The Elizabeth Hospice is a nonprofit organization providing hospice care, palliative care, and grief support services to children and adults facing advanced serious illness and loss. They serve over 150,000 people in San Diego and Southwest Riverside counties since 1978, offering medical, emotional, and spiritual support.

name: La Costa Glen
description: La Costa Glen is an award-winning resort-style senior living community in Carlsbad, California, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing. It provides residents with amenities, activities, dining, and health services on a 200-acre campus, ensuring a comprehensive plan for future care.

name: Nazareth House
description: Sisters of Nazareth provides care for older people through care homes, retirement villages, and assisted living facilities, offering residential, nursing, dementia, and palliative care across five regions globally. They also focus on education and responding to community needs.

name: Belmont Village Senior Living
description: Belmont Village Senior Living provides best-in-class hospitality, care, and programs for seniors, offering independent living, assisted living, and memory care services. They serve older adults with varying needs, focusing on health, wellness, and engaging programs, supported by licensed nurses on-site 24/7.

name: Brookdale Carlsbad
description: Brookdale Senior Living provides a range of senior care services, including assisted living, independent living, memory care, skilled nursing, and at-home care. It serves seniors and their families by offering supportive communities and personalized care options across numerous locations.

name: Carlsbad By the Sea Retirement
description: Carlsbad By The Sea is a Front Porch Community offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing services in Carlsbad, CA. It serves seniors, providing a coastal retirement community experience with various amenities and care options.

name: Casa De Las Campanas
description: Casa de las Campanas is a not-for-profit Life Plan Community in San Diego, CA, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, and rehabilitation services. It serves seniors with a full continuum of care options, including Type A and Type C contracts.

name: La Vida Real
description: La Vida Real, part of SRG Senior Living, provides a range of living choices for seniors in Rancho San Diego, CA, including independent living, assisted living, memory care, and integrated health care. They focus on resident experience, offering various lifestyle programs and wellness initiatives.

name: Lantern Crest Senior Living
description: Lantern Crest Senior Living is a large community in Santee, California, offering independent living, assisted living, and memory care for seniors. They provide comprehensive medical services, daily living assistance, and a wide range of amenities like meals, activities, and transportation, ensuring a supportive and engaging environment.

name: Pacifica Senior Living Vista
description: Pacifica Senior Living Vista is a large senior living community in Vista, California, offering independent living, assisted living, and memory care. It provides comprehensive services including nursing, medication management, and daily activity assistance, serving seniors with diverse care needs.

name: Remington Club
description: The Remington Club is a senior living community in San Diego, California, offering independent and assisted living options. It provides premier amenities, exquisite dining, and personalized care plans, serving seniors by handling routine tasks and assisting with daily needs to elevate their lifestyle.

name: Silverado Senior Living
description: Silverado Senior Living provides top-rated memory care and assisted living services, focusing on personalized, holistic care for individuals with memory impairment. They operate numerous communities across multiple states, including California, offering amenities like community pets, gourmet food, and purposeful design.

name: Info Line of San Diego County
description: 211 San Diego is a free, 24-hour confidential phone service and searchable online database, serving the San Diego / Imperial region. It connects individuals with resources for food, housing, utility assistance, and health information, operating as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

name: Interfaith Community Services
description: Interfaith Community Services empowers people in need in the San Diego / Imperial region of California by providing comprehensive programs including food, housing, substance use treatment, and senior support. The organization serves over 80 unique clients, distributing emergency food kits and preventing homelessness through case management and over 75 programs.

name: Jewish Family Services of San Diego
description: Jewish Family Service of San Diego provides comprehensive social services to individuals and families in the San Diego / Imperial region. They offer nutrition assistance, support for adults, families, older adults, immigrants, and refugees, and economic mobility programs. Key activities include food distribution, case management, transportation, and legal services, aiming to empower the community to achieve their full potential.

name: Lawrence Family Jewish Community
description: The Lawrence Family Jewish Community Center provides diverse programs and services for San Diego's Jewish and general community, including sports, fitness, aquatics, early childhood education, youth and teen activities, and cultural events through the San Diego Center for Jewish Culture. It aims to create a welcoming and inclusive environment for all ages.

name: Neighborhood House Association
description: Neighborhood House Association is one of San Diego County's largest nonprofit social service agencies, established in 1914. It provides comprehensive human services including early childhood development (Head Start), youth services, senior services, nutrition programs, and health programs like HIV/AIDS case management and mental health services, serving diverse communities.

name: New Haven Youth and Family Services
description: New Haven Youth and Family Services provides therapeutic education and career technical training to over 18,250 youth and their families in California. They offer programs like Woodcrafts, Etc. and Catering4Youth Academy, aiming to restore hope and build self-sufficiency for troubled youth through accredited special education and social services.

name: Planned Parenthood
description: Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and its affiliates provide sexual and reproductive health care and education, including birth control, abortion, STD testing, and cancer screenings. They serve people of all genders across the U.S. through in-person and online services.

name: Salvation Army Kroc Corps
description: The Salvation Army Kroc Corps in San Diego is a 12.4-acre community center offering diverse programs for all ages, including health, wellness, arts, education, and recreation. It serves individuals and families through facilities like an ice arena, pools, and gym, fostering personal development and community engagement.

name: Social Advocates for Youth
description: Social Advocates for Youth (SAY San Diego) is a nonprofit organization established in 1971, serving over 30,000 San Diegans annually. They offer over 30 programs, including family support, preschools, extended learning, youth development, health navigation, and mental health support, aiming to strengthen the whole child, family, and community.

name: UCSD Cancer Prevention Center
description: UC San Diego Health's Moores Cancer Center, San Diego's only NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, offers personalized care and advanced treatments for over 200 cancer types. Serving patients across San Diego County, it provides comprehensive cancer care, clinical trials, prevention, and supportive services.

name: UPAC Neighborhood Empowerment Center
description: The Union of Pan Asian Communities (UPAC) is a multicultural Behavioral Health Organization in San Diego, serving diverse, underserved, and vulnerable communities. They provide person-centered, holistic services, including mental health, addiction treatment, and community engagement programs, serving over 7,000 unique clients annually.

name: Veterans Village of San Diego
description: Veterans Village of San Diego (VVSD) is a nationally recognized nonprofit serving over 3,000 military veterans and their families annually across five San Diego County locations since 1981. It provides comprehensive services including housing, workforce development, and mental health care to overcome homelessness, unemployment, and health barriers.

name: St. Vincent de Paul Village
description: St. Vincent de Paul Village (Father Joe's Villages) is San Diego's largest residential homeless services provider, offering comprehensive care to over 1,000 individuals daily. They provide housing, thousands of meals, medical, mental health, and dental care through their Federally Qualified Health Center, along with job training and recovery services to end homelessness.

name: Arc of San Diego North County
description: The Arc of San Diego supports and empowers children and adults with disabilities, offering services like early intervention, day training, community inclusion, residential living, and employment assistance. They operate across multiple centers in the San Diego region, including a North County Center, to promote independence and community integration.

name: San Diego Workforce Partnership
description: The San Diego Workforce Partnership is the designated Workforce Development Board for San Diego County, funding and delivering job training programs and employment services. It serves job seekers, including youth and low-income adults, and businesses across various sectors, notably healthcare, through 15 America's Job Center sites.

name: Sharp Rehabilitation Services
description: Sharp Rehabilitation Services offers comprehensive inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation across San Diego, aiding recovery from serious illness, injury, and chronic pain. They provide physical, occupational, and speech therapies, serving adults and children with conditions like stroke, spinal cord, and brain injuries.

name: Toward Maximum Independence
description: Toward Maximum Independence (TMI) is a nonprofit founded in 1981, serving children and adults with intellectual/developmental disabilities, the Deaf/Hard of Hearing, and veterans with disabilities across San Diego, Imperial, and Riverside Counties. TMI provides employment solutions, supported living, and family support services, including foster family placements, to foster independence and community integration.

name: Harmonium
description: Harmonium is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization in San Diego that provides services to advance the well-being of children, youth, and families. Key activities include before & after school programs, integrated community behavioral health, and community education & advocacy, impacting approximately 30,000 individuals annually.

name: Belmont Park
description: Belmont Park is a legendary amusement park in San Diego's Mission Beach, offering rides, attractions, dining at 17 unique destinations, shopping, and event hosting across seven acres. Established in 1925, it serves visitors seeking thrills and entertainment with beachfront fun.

name: LEGOLAND California Resort
description: LEGOLAND California Resort is a family theme park located in Carlsbad, CA, offering over 60 rides, shows, and attractions across three parks: LEGOLAND California Theme Park, SEA LIFE Aquarium, and LEGOLAND Water Park. It serves families with children ages 2 to 12, providing themed hotels and STEM-based experiences.

name: SeaWorld San Diego
description: SeaWorld San Diego is an accredited aquarium, zoo, and theme park offering rides, roller coasters, and diverse animal presentations and interactions. It serves guests of all ages, focusing on marine life education and conservation, including rescuing and rehabilitating over 42,000 animals.

name: Sesame Place San Diego
description: Sesame Place San Diego is a family theme park and water park that brings the imagination of Sesame Street to life, offering family-friendly rides, shows, parades, character meet-and-greets, and dining experiences. It serves families and operates as a Certified Autism Center, providing entertainment and employment opportunities in the San Diego region.

name: Wave Water Park
description: The Wave Waterpark, located in Vista, CA, provides aquatic recreation and entertainment. It serves individuals and groups through attractions, season passes, swim lessons, splash camps, and private rentals, operating as a community-focused recreational facility.

name: Crosby National Golf Course
description: The Crosby Club is a private golf club in Rancho Santa Fe, San Diego, offering a premier golf course, modern fitness center with a pool, and gourmet dining and social events. It serves members seeking a luxurious and engaging club experience in Southern California.

name: Andaz San Diego
description: Andaz San Diego is a boutique hotel in the Gaslamp Quarter, offering contemporary lodging, dining at The Rooftop by STK and STK Steakhouse, and event venues. It serves guests seeking upscale hospitality, nightlife, and attractions in downtown San Diego, including meetings and weddings.

name: Best Western Plus Isla Palms
description: Best Western Hotels & Resorts operates a global network of independently owned and operated hotels, including the Best Western Plus brand. They serve travelers by offering various lodging options with amenities like free breakfast and internet, across over 100 countries and territories worldwide.

name: Best Western Seven Seas
description: Best Western Seven Seas is the largest Best Western hotel on the West Coast, offering over 300 guest rooms in San Diego's Mission Valley. It provides accommodations for tourists and business travelers, featuring on-site dining, an outdoor pool, hot tubs, and meeting facilities.

name: Cape Rey Carlsbad Beach
description: Cape Rey Carlsbad Beach, a Hilton Resort & Spa, is a California coastal resort offering luxurious rooms, oceanfront dining, a spa, and activities like golf and family fun. It serves leisure and business travelers, as well as those planning weddings and events in the San Diego region.

name: Catamaran Resort Hotel
description: The Catamaran Resort Hotel and Spa is a Polynesian-themed beachfront resort in San Diego's Pacific Beach, offering accommodations, dining, spa services, and activities. It serves leisure travelers, as well as groups for weddings, meetings, and other celebrations, providing a range of amenities and event spaces.

name: Coronado Island Marriott Resort
description: This is a resort hotel on Coronado Island.

name: Courtyard San Diego Central
description: Marriott International operates a global portfolio of hotels and resorts, including the Courtyard brand, offering accommodations, dining, and event services. They serve leisure and business travelers worldwide with diverse lodging options and a loyalty program, Marriott Bonvoy.

name: Courtyard San Diego Mission Valley
description: Courtyard San Diego Mission Valley, part of Marriott's global hospitality network, provides modern and consistent lodging for travelers. It offers hotel accommodations, serving guests seeking comfortable stays in the San Diego region.

name: Dana on Mission Bay
description: The Dana on Mission Bay is a waterfront resort in San Diego, California, offering hotel accommodations, dining at Firefly Eatery & Bar, and event hosting. It serves leisure, family, and business travelers with amenities like two pools, a private marina, and water sport rentals across its 10-acre property.

name: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Diego
description: Embassy Suites by Hilton provides spacious two-room suite accommodations for leisure and business travelers across the US, Canada, Middle East, Caribbean, and South America. They offer amenities like complimentary made-to-order breakfast, evening receptions, fitness centers, and meeting/event spaces, catering to diverse guest needs.

name: Estancia La Jolla Hotel & Spa
description: Estancia La Jolla Hotel & Spa is a AAA Four Diamond hacienda-style resort in La Jolla, California, offering 210 guest rooms and suites, a full-service spa, multiple dining options, and event venues for meetings and weddings. It serves leisure and business travelers seeking a luxury Southern California experience.

name: Evans Hotels
description: Evans Hotels is a family-owned hospitality leader in San Diego, operating luxury hotels and resorts like The Lodge at Torrey Pines and Bahia Resort Hotel since 1953. It provides upscale accommodations, amenities, dining, and spa services to guests in the region.

name: Four Points by Sheraton San Diego
description: Four Points by Sheraton San Diego is a hospitality provider offering 223-225 guest rooms, dining at on-site restaurants and bars, and event spaces for business and leisure travelers in San Diego's Kearny Mesa Business District. Key activities include lodging, food service, and hosting meetings and social gatherings.

name: Four Seasons Residence Club
description: Four Seasons Residence Club Aviara, in Carlsbad, San Diego, offers luxury villa rentals and fractional ownership. It provides upscale accommodations, resort amenities like pools, fitness centers, and dining, serving families and travelers seeking a high-end vacation experience. The property features 246 villas.

name: Golden Door
description: Golden Door is a luxury wellness resort in San Marcos, CA, offering transformative experiences for mind, body, and spirit. It provides rejuvenating classes, private hiking, personal training, and farm-to-table meals, serving guests seeking personal restoration.

name: Grand Del Mar Resort, Spa, and Golf
description: Fairmont Grand Del Mar is a luxury 5-star resort in San Diego, California, offering 249 guestrooms, suites, and villas. It provides diverse hospitality services including an 18-hole golf course, a five-star spa, four pools, and six dining venues, including a three-Michelin-starred restaurant, serving leisure and event guests.

name: Grand Pacific Palisades Resort
description: Grand Pacific Palisades Resort in Carlsbad, CA, offers luxury 1 and 2-bedroom condo accommodations with full kitchens. It serves families and travelers seeking amenities like pools, a fitness center, and dining, located near LEGOLAND California and the Flower Fields.

name: Grande Colonial
description: The Grande Colonial is a four-diamond boutique hotel in La Jolla, California, offering luxury accommodations, including rooms, suites, and extended-stay vacation rentals. It serves leisure and business travelers, providing event spaces for meetings and weddings, and features the MICHELIN Guide-recognized NINE-TEN Restaurant.

name: Camp Mountain Chai
description: Camp Mountain Chai is San Diego's premier Jewish overnight camp, offering summer programs and year-round retreats. It provides a camper experience focused on Jewish life, activities, and community building, serving Jewish youth and their families. The organization emphasizes character development and offers financial assistance.

name: Campland On the Bay
description: This is a campground located on the bay.

name: Qdoba Restaurant Corporation
description: Qdoba Restaurant Corporation, established in 1995, operates as Qdoba Mexican Eats, a restaurant chain serving Mexican cuisine such as bowls, burritos, and tacos. They provide dine-in, online ordering, and catering services to communities across the U.S. and Canada, focusing on flavorful food and customer rewards.

name: Barleymash
description: Barleymash is a hospitality and food service establishment located in San Diego's Gaslamp District. It offers dining, takeout, private events, and catering services, serving customers seeking food, drinks, and event hosting in a lively atmosphere.

name: Benihana
description: Benihana is a hospitality and food service organization specializing in teppanyaki and sushi, offering an iconic dining experience with chefs cooking at the table. They serve guests through dine-in, takeout, catering, and private dining, with gift cards available for purchase.

name: Bistro West Carlsbad
description: Bistro West Carlsbad is a farm-to-table restaurant in Carlsbad, CA, offering diverse menu options to diners. It emphasizes sustainability and fresh ingredients, providing a quality dining experience.

name: Brigantine
description: Brigantine Seafood & Oyster Bar, established in 1969, operates a family of restaurants specializing in seafood and oyster bar offerings. Serving the San Diego / Imperial region, they provide dining experiences and event hosting across multiple locations including Coronado, Point Loma, and Del Mar.

name: C Level Lounge
description: C Level Lounge, part of Cohn Restaurant Group, is a San Diego restaurant on Harbor Island offering California Coastal Cuisine, including fresh seafood and premium meats. Open daily for lunch and dinner, it provides guests with stunning views of the San Diego Bay and downtown skyline from its expansive patio.

name: Cafe Sevilla Restaurant
description: Cafe Sevilla Restaurant offers authentic Spanish dining and entertainment, including tapas, live Latin music, and flamenco dinner shows. Serving customers in Southern California, with locations in San Diego and Costa Mesa, it provides a vibrant atmosphere for dining, private events, and nightlife.

name: Casa de Bandini at the Forum
description: Casa de Bandini at The Forum is a Mexican restaurant in Carlsbad, California, offering authentic Mexican food, mariachi entertainment, homemade tortillas, and a cantina with over 60 tequilas. It serves customers seeking a festive dining experience with traditional dishes and award-winning seafood.

name: Casa de Pico
description: Casa de Pico is an internationally renowned Mexican restaurant in La Mesa, CA, originally established in 1971. It offers authentic Mexican cuisine, hosts various events like weddings and birthdays, and provides online ordering and gift cards, serving customers seeking a festive dining experience.

name: Casa Guadalajara
description: Casa Guadalajara is a popular Mexican restaurant in Old Town San Diego, serving traditional and contemporary cuisine to locals and visitors for over 30 years. It offers indoor and outdoor dining, live mariachi music, and hosts private events for groups up to 100, with key activities including fresh food preparation and beverage service.

name: Champagne French Bakery Cafe
description: Champagne Bakery is a food service establishment offering pickup, delivery, and catering services. They provide a restaurant menu and a catering menu, serving customers in locations such as Carmel Mountain and Encinitas. Key offerings include Boudin San Francisco Sourdough, Pinsa Pizza, and sandwiches.

name: Auto Glass Now
description: Auto Glass Now provides windshield and auto glass repair and replacement services, including side and rear windows, and ADAS calibration. With over 30 years in the industry, they serve individual vehicle owners and commercial fleets, offering mobile repair, insurance claims management, and a lifetime warranty.

name: Mitchell Repair Info
description: Mitchell 1 provides auto repair software and shop management solutions, including diagnostic, estimating, and OEM repair information for autos, light-duty, and Class 4-8 trucks. They serve dealerships, general auto repair shops, multi-shop operations, and fleet operators, aiming to increase shop productivity and profitability.
swp_sectors: Information and Communication Technologies - Digital Media

name: St-Gobain Solar Gard
description: Solar Gard, a division of Saint-Gobain, manufactures and distributes high-performance window films and paint protection films. They serve residential, commercial, automotive, and marine markets globally, offering products for energy savings, UV protection, safety, security, and aesthetic enhancement.

name: Symbolic Motors
description: Symbolic Motors is a San Diego-based luxury automotive group, offering sales, service, and restoration of Bentley, Bugatti, Lamborghini, and Rolls-Royce vehicles, alongside classic and competition cars. Serving high-end enthusiasts, they operate with 21-50 employees, specializing in rare and exotic automobiles.

name: Vital Climbing Gym
description: Vital Climbing Gym operates bouldering and fitness facilities in the San Diego/Imperial region, including Carlsbad and Oceanside, serving climbers of all levels and fitness enthusiasts. They offer 24/7 member access, diverse training equipment, and fitness classes.

name: San Diego Zoo Safari Park
description: The San Diego Zoo Safari Park, part of the San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, is an international nonprofit conservation organization. It integrates wildlife health, science, and education to develop sustainable conservation solutions worldwide, serving the public through park visits and engaging supporters in global conservation efforts.

name: Irvine Ranch Water District
description: The Irvine Ranch Water District provides water and sewer services, including recycled water, to residential and commercial customers in the Orange County region of California. They manage facilities like water treatment plants and reservoirs, focusing on water supply, reliability, and conservation through various programs and initiatives.

name: Orange County Water District
description: The Orange County Water District manages and protects groundwater resources for the Orange County region of California. Key activities include groundwater management, water quality, water reuse through the Groundwater Replenishment System, and environmental stewardship, producing over 516 billion gallons of water.

name: Santa Margarita Water District
description: Santa Margarita Water District provides high-quality drinking, recycled, and wastewater services to over 200,000 residents across ten communities in South Orange County, California. As the second largest retail water agency, it focuses on reliable water supply and conservation efforts.

name: Cal Atlantic Homes
description: Cal Atlantic Homes is a home builder that constructs residential properties.

name: Griffith
description: Griffith Company is a Southern California-based, employee-owned general contractor specializing in heavy civil engineering and roadway construction. Founded in 1902, they build and maintain streets, highways, airports, and rail, serving various agencies and owners across the region with a workforce of 501-1,000 employees.

name: KDC Construction
description: KDC Inc. provides full-service electrical preconstruction and construction services, including electrical systems design, alternative energy, energy-management systems, technology services, and facilities-maintenance services. They offer high-performance electrical construction solutions for a broad range of industrial and commercial markets.

name: KHS & S Contractors
description: KHS&S Contractors is an international design-assist specialty building company based in Anaheim, CA, specializing in interiors, exteriors, themed environments, rockwork, and specialty finishes. They provide prefabrication, design-assist, and construction design services for recognized projects worldwide, consistently ranked as a top Specialty Wall & Ceiling Contractor.

name: KPRS
description: KPRS is a full-service general construction company that builds structures and environments across various sectors including office, residential, industrial, public works, retail, and medical. Serving clients in Orange County, Los Angeles, Northern California, and Hawaii, KPRS offers preconstruction, construction, and design-build services.

name: Lennar Communities

description: Brookhurst Junior High School provides comprehensive education, including academic programs, athletics, and counseling, to students within the Anaheim Union High School District in Anaheim, CA. name: Calvary Chapel
description: Calvary Chapel is a global network of churches focused on Christian living, discipleship, and theological education. description: Calvary Church of Santa Ana is a Bible-teaching church established in 1931, serving Orange County and globally. It offers worship services, ministries for all ages, community groups, and resources like a Christian school and soul care, aiming to connect people with God and foster spiritual growth.

description: Canyon High School is a public high school in Anaheim Hills, California, serving approximately 2,200 students in grades 9-12. description: Capistrano Valley High School is a public high school in Mission Viejo, California, serving approximately 1,981 students in grades 9-12 from South Orange County. description: Centralia Elementary School District is a public education provider in Orange County, California, serving approximately 4,000-4,500 Preschool through 6th-grade students across eight elementary schools in Buena Park, Anaheim, and La Palma. name: College & Career Advantage
description: College & Career Advantage (CCA) is a joint partnership of Capistrano and Laguna Beach Unified School Districts in Orange County, California. It provides career technical education and pathways for high school students and adults, preparing them for academic and career success through industry-aligned courses, internships, and certifications across 15 industry sectors.

name: Corona Del Mar Middle-High School
description: Corona del Mar Middle and High School provides education for middle and high school students in Newport Beach, CA, offering academic programs, college and career guidance, arts, athletics, and career and technical education. It is part of the Newport-Mesa Unified School District.

description: Costa Mesa Middle and High School provides education for middle and high school students in the Newport-Mesa Unified School District. It offers a range of academic programs, including Career Technical Education (CTE), arts, and athletics, serving the Orange County region of California.

name: Crean Lutheran High School
description: Crean Lutheran High School provides Christian education in Orange County, California, serving high school students through comprehensive academic, arts, and athletic programs. Key activities include admissions, counseling, and fostering student life and campus ministry, aiming for excellence in education.

name: Cristo Rey O.C. High School
description: Cristo Rey Orange County High School is a Catholic learning community in Santa Ana, CA, providing a college preparatory education to young people of limited economic means. The school integrates a rigorous curriculum with a Corporate Work Study program, where students work five days a month at Orange County businesses to earn a significant portion of their education and gain professional experience.

name: Cypress High School
description: Cypress High School is an educational institution in Cypress, CA, part of the Anaheim Union High School District. It serves students by offering academic programs, athletics, counseling, and dual enrollment with Cypress College, providing resources for students, parents, and staff.

name: Coast Community College District
description: The Coast Community College District serves the Orange County region of California, operating Coastline College, Golden West College, and Orange Coast College. It provides educational opportunities, including admissions, registration, financial aid, and transfer services, to students and the community.

name: Coastline College
description: Coastline College is an accredited community college offering over 120 degrees and certificates, including online programs and competency-based education. It serves high school graduates, busy adults, transfer students, and military personnel, with a focus on workforce development and academic support in Orange County, California.

name: Golden West College

name: Orange Coast College
description: Orange Coast College is a community college in Orange County, California, offering over 135 academic and career programs, including 28 Associate Degrees for Transfer. It serves students seeking to transfer to four-year universities or gain marketable skills for high-demand jobs, and is recognized as the #1 transfer college in Orange County.

description: Associated Students UC Irvine (ASUCI) is the undergraduate student government, advocating for students at university, local, state, and federal levels. It provides club funding, entertainment, and direct services like transportation, serving the UC Irvine undergraduate community through various branches and elected officials.

name: Southern California College of Optometry
description: Marshall B. Ketchum University, including its Southern California College of Optometry, educates future eye care professionals and other healthcare providers. Established in 1904, it offers programs in optometry, physician assistant studies, pharmacy, and medical science, emphasizing interprofessional, patient-centric care.

name: UC Irvine Athletics

It serves student-athletes and the broader community through competitions, events, and outreach, fostering athletic development and engagement in Orange County.

description: UCI Campus Recreation provides diverse recreational facilities and programs, including competitive and intramural sports, fitness, and outdoor adventures, primarily serving the UC Irvine community. description: Orange County School of the Arts (OCSA) provides an unparalleled arts and academic education to a diverse student body passionate about the arts. Located in Santa Ana, CA, OCSA prepares students for their highest potential through various schools including Dance, Music, Theatre, Fine & Media Arts, and Applied Arts. OCSA has also expanded to a regional campus, California School of the Arts – San Gabriel Valley.

name: Speech and Language Development Center
description: The Speech and Language Development Center is a non-profit special education school and therapy center in Orange County, California. It provides education and comprehensive therapies, including speech, occupational, and physical therapy, to approximately 250-300 children and adults (ages 6 months to 21 years) with diverse special needs, fostering growth and maximizing potential.

name: Waterworks Aquatics
description: Waterworks Aquatics is a swim school offering high-quality swim instruction and programs for all ages and skill levels, from infants to adults. They provide private, semi-private, and Parent & Me lessons, along with swim teams, competitions, and aquatic physical therapy. Serving multiple regions including Orange County, they focus on water safety and skill development.

description: AltaMed Medical and Dental Group provides comprehensive healthcare services, including primary, dental, women's, senior, and pharmacy care, plus urgent care and telehealth. description: Kaiser Permanente Southern California provides custom care and coverage, integrating doctors, hospitals, and health plans to offer convenient access to care through various channels like phone, email, and video. description: St. Jude Heritage Family Medical Group provides comprehensive primary and specialty healthcare, including family medicine, pediatrics, and orthopedics, to individuals and families across Orange County and Southern California. Key activities include clinical trials, drug screening, and population health management.

description: Care To Stay Home provides non-medical, in-home care services, including personal, companion, social, and specialized care, to aging, recovering, disabled, chronically, or terminally ill individuals. It serves customers through dine-in, pickup, and delivery options, with a focus on casual dining and happy hour specials. The organization also provides gift cards and party platters.

description: Claim Jumper Steakhouse & Bar is a restaurant offering freshly prepared lunch and dinner items, including steaks, seafood, ribs, pizzas, and desserts. It serves guests in multiple states, providing dine-in, delivery, pickup, catering, and private event services.

name: Del Frisco's Grille
description: Del Frisco's Grille operates restaurants offering familiar favorites with a modern touch in a sociable atmosphere. They serve diners across multiple states, providing restaurant services, private dining, catering, and online ordering.

name: Duke's
description: Duke's Huntington Beach is a Hawaiian-style restaurant offering fresh fish, steak, and island favorites in its dining room, alongside tropical cocktails at its Barefoot bar. It serves guests for lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch, providing a casual to fine dining experience in Orange County.

name: Lexus of Tustin
description: Lexus of Tustin is an Orange County automotive dealership selling new Lexus models and various pre-owned vehicles. It provides financing, leasing, and a full-service center for maintenance, repair, and parts, serving customers in the Tustin, Irvine, and Anaheim areas.

name: Orange County Sheriff's Department
description: The Orange County Sheriff's Department provides law enforcement, custodial operations, investigations, and patrol services across Orange County, California. It serves the community by ensuring public safety, managing correctional facilities, and conducting various specialized operations, including emergency management and crime lab services.

name: Santa Ana Jail
description: The Santa Ana Jail, part of the Santa Ana Police Department, provides public safety services to the community of Santa Ana, California. It manages inmate services including visitation, education, and health, and offers a Pay-to-Stay Program.

name: Brea Community Services
description: Brea Community Services, a department of the City of Brea, provides diverse recreation, arts, and human services to all age groups in Brea and surrounding communities. It operates the Brea Community Center, Fitness Center, and Resource Center, offering programs, classes, special events, and counseling.

name: Orange County Hazardous Waste Management
description: Orange County Hazardous Waste Management, part of OC Waste & Recycling, provides free disposal services for household hazardous waste and e-waste to Orange County residents. Operating four collection centers, it ensures proper management of materials like paints, oils, and batteries, promoting environmental protection and recycling.

name: Pacific Coast Producers
description: Pacific Coast Producers is an agricultural cooperative owned by over 150 family farms in Central and Northern California. They specialize in canning fruits and tomatoes for private brands worldwide, producing shelf-stable items like diced tomatoes, peach halves, and fruit bowls.

name: Wrex Products Inc
description: Wrex Products Inc. is a contract manufacturer in Chico, CA, specializing in plastic injection molding, die casting, and powder coating. They provide complete manufacturing solutions, including medical devices, serving over 600 customers from small businesses to multi-billion-dollar corporations.

name: Agromillora California
description: Agromillora is a global leader in plant propagation and innovation, specializing in developing and commercializing high-quality plant materials and rootstocks for various crops like almonds, olives, citrus, and stone fruits. They serve growers worldwide, offering sustainable and efficient agricultural solutions through their genetics and agribusiness platforms.

name: Chico Sports Club
description: Chico Sports Club facilitates healthy lifestyles for its community members, offering training, movement classes, and a heated pool. It serves individuals of all ages and fitness levels, providing superior customer service and childcare services to assist members in achieving a healthier way of life.

name: Enloe Medical Center
description: Enloe Health is a proudly independent, nonprofit health system in Chico, CA, offering an array of medical services. It operates a 264-bed hospital, a Level II Trauma Center, and California's only hospital-owned air ambulance service, serving the community with comprehensive care including cancer, heart, and orthopedic services.

name: Northern Valley Catholic
description: Northern Valley Catholic Social Service (NVCSS) offers over 60 programs across six counties in Northern California, including Butte, Glenn, Shasta, Siskiyou, Tehama, and Trinity. They provide compassionate services such as housing, mental health support, disaster relief, family services, and immigrant support, aiming to bring stability, dignity, and hope to individuals and families facing challenges like poverty, hunger, homelessness, and mental health issues.

name: Enloe Homecare
description: Enloe Health is a proudly independent, nonprofit health system in Chico, CA, offering a wide array of medical services, including a 264-bed hospital, a Level II Trauma Center, and an air ambulance service. They provide comprehensive care in areas like cancer, heart, orthopedics, and maternity, serving patients across the region.

name: BMW of Chico
description: BMW of Chico is a new and pre-owned car dealership in Chico, CA, offering sales of luxury BMW sedans, SUVs, and electrified vehicles. They also provide expert maintenance, repair, parts, and financing services, serving customers in Northern California, including Yuba City and Paradise.

name: Pajouh Automotive Group
description: Pajouh Automotive Center, formerly Courtesy Automotive Center, operates multiple dealerships in Chico, CA, including GMC, Mercedes-Benz, Subaru, Cadillac, Volvo, and BMW. They offer new and pre-owned vehicle sales, certified pre-owned options, and comprehensive services like parts, tire centers, auto detailing, and collision repair. The center also provides financing options and serves drivers in the Chico, CA area.

name: Wittmeier Chevrolet
description: Wittmeier Chevrolet is a car dealership in Chico, CA, serving the Far North region of California, including Corning and Oroville. They sell new and pre-owned Chevrolet cars, trucks, and SUVs, offer financing, and provide vehicle service, parts, and accessories.

name: Save Mart
description: Save Mart is a retail grocery chain offering a wide range of products including food, beverages, household items, and personal care products. They serve customers with options for online ordering, delivery, and free in-store pickup, along with a rewards program for savings on groceries and fuel.

name: S-S Organic Produce
description: S&S Organic Produce and Natural Foods is a locally owned and operated retail store in Chico, California, offering a wide selection of local, organic, and fresh natural foods, body and supplements, natural meats, fresh seafood, and deli/BBQ items. It serves the community by providing quality products and supporting sustainable agriculture.

name: Waste Management North Valley
description: WM, formerly Waste Management, is North America's leading provider of comprehensive environmental solutions, offering residential and commercial waste pickup, recycling services, and roll-off dumpster rentals. They serve homes and businesses, providing essential waste disposal and recycling options.

name: Sutter Coast Hospital
description: Sutter Health is a not-for-profit healthcare organization serving Northern and Central California. It provides comprehensive services including primary care, specialty care, urgent care, and emergency care, along with patient resources like My Health Online. Sutter Health is recognized for excellence in quality and patient safety.

name: Hambro Forest Products
description: Hambro Forest Products, based in Crescent City, CA, operates as a home center retailing building materials. The company also provides comprehensive waste management, including operating the Del Norte County Transfer Station and CRV recycling, alongside truckload transportation and repair services for the North Coast region.

name: Elk Valley Casino
description: Elk Valley Casino is a Northern California gaming and entertainment destination offering over 300 slot machines, a poker room, and table games like blackjack. It also features dining at Warrior's Bar & Grill, a coffee and gift shop, and live entertainment, serving visitors seeking gaming and leisure experiences.

name: Sunsweet Dryers
description: Sunsweet Growers is a grower-owned cooperative established in 1917, responsible for 20% of the world's prune production. They produce and market prunes, prune juices, and various dried fruits like mango, apricots, and dates, serving consumers globally with nutritious fruit products.

name: Sierra Nevada Cheese
description: Sierra Nevada Cheese Company produces pasture-raised and traditionally made cow and goat dairy products, including cheese, yogurt, butter, and cultured items. They partner with local, multi-generational farmers, serving consumers and food service/bulk orders with a focus on quality and natural ingredients.

name: Humboldt Creamery
description: Humboldt Creamery produces delicious, healthy, super premium dairy products, ranging from organic classics to new favorites, for consumers. Their products are made from milk sourced from cows in Humboldt County, California, reflecting a commitment to natural and high-quality dairy production.

name: North Coast Co-Op
description: North Coast Co-op is a community-owned grocery cooperative in Humboldt County, California, operating since 1973. It sells a variety of grocery items, including fresh produce and local products from Humboldt, Trinity, and Del Norte counties, supporting over 120 local vendors and serving over 22,000 owners.

name: Hospice of Humboldt
description: Hospice of Humboldt provides comfort and care for individuals with life-threatening illnesses, focusing on quality of life, pain control, and symptom management for all diagnoses and ages. They also offer grief support services, palliative care, and operate the Ida Emmerson Hospice House.

name: Humboldt County Department of Health
description: Humboldt County Department of Health, as part of the Humboldt County government, provides health and human services to its residents. It addresses local healthcare challenges, offers COVID information, and supports medical education and workforce development, serving the community across the Far North region of California.

name: St Joseph Health Medical Group
description: Providence, including St. Joseph Health Medical Group, is a not-for-profit health system providing world-class healthcare across the Western U.S.. They offer comprehensive services like primary care, urgent care, specialty treatments (e.g., cancer, heart & vascular, orthopedics), and virtual care, serving diverse communities.

name: United Indian Health Services
description: United Indian Health Services (UIHS) is a healthcare organization celebrating 55 years of service to the American Indian Community in Northern California. UIHS provides comprehensive medical, dental, pharmacy, vision, and behavioral health services across multiple clinics, focusing on proactive preventative care and reflecting traditional values.

name: Humboldt County Mental Health
description: Humboldt County Mental Health provides mental health services and support to residents.

name: Providence St Joseph Hospital
description: Providence is a not-for-profit health system providing world-class healthcare across the Western U.S.. It offers comprehensive medical services, including cancer, heart, women's health, and primary care, through hospitals, urgent care, and virtual appointments. Providence is dedicated to serving all, especially the poor and vulnerable.

name: Redwood Memorial Hospital
description: Providence is a not-for-profit health system serving the Western U.S., providing world-class health care with human connection. They offer comprehensive services including cancer treatment, heart and vascular care, orthopedics, primary care, and urgent care, serving patients through hospitals, clinics, and virtual appointments.

name: Fortuna Rehabilitation and Wellness
description: Fortuna Rehabilitation & Wellness Center provides short-term and long-term rehabilitative and nursing care in Eureka, CA. Services include physical and speech therapy, 24-hour nursing, respite care, and hospice support, serving patients needing comprehensive wellness and recovery programs.

name: Granada Rehabilitation and Wellness
description: Granada Rehabilitation and Wellness Center offers high-quality nursing and rehabilitative care in Eureka, CA. They provide services including rehabilitation therapy, long-term care, respite care, hospice, and short-term care, educating patients on their condition and re-injury prevention.

name: Suddenlink
description: Suddenlink, a former Altice USA subsidiary, provided cable television, high-speed internet, and phone services to residential and business customers across 13 states, including California. It has since rebranded and is now fully integrated into Optimum, a larger connectivity provider.

name: Pierson Building Center
description: Pierson Building Center is Humboldt County's home center, providing building materials, lumber, garden supplies, and cabinets. Serving customers in Eureka, CA, it operates a main store with various departments, a garden shop, and a lumber yard.

name: Healthsport
description: HealthSPORT operates fitness clubs in Arcata, Eureka, McKinleyville, and Fortuna, offering a range of services including group fitness classes, personal training, swim lessons, gymnastics, and youth camps. It serves individuals of all ages and stages, aiming to empower health and wellness within the Humboldt community.

name: Red Lion Hotel Eureka
description: Red Lion Hotel Eureka, part of Sonesta International Hotels Corporation, provides hospitality services. It offers accommodations for business and leisure travelers, with a wide range of experiences across its over 1,100 hotels in the U.S. and beyond, including meetings and events.

name: Calpine
description: Calpine is America's premier competitive power company, generating approximately 27,000 megawatts of clean and reliable electricity from 78 facilities across North America. It serves about 27 million homes and businesses, offering retail energy solutions and developing carbon capture technologies for a clean energy future.

name: Scully Packing
description: Scully Packing Company LLC is a California-based organization specializing in packing and selling premium pears. They operate a packinghouse and cold storage facilities, serving customers seeking California's best pears. Key activities include food safety, sustainability, and managing sales for various pear varieties.

name: Adventist Health Clear Lake
description: Adventist Health Clear Lake provides comprehensive healthcare services, including emergency, heart and vascular, primary care, and surgery, to the community. With over 1,400 caregivers, the organization focuses on high-quality, personalized, whole-person care for patients and families.

name: Rancheria Grille
description: Robinson Rancheria Resort & Casino, located on the north shore of Clear Lake, operates a large casino with slots, table games, and a 900-seat bingo facility. It also features dining options like The Grill, a hotel, and entertainment, serving guests in the Far North region of California.

name: Forestry and Fire Protection
description: The California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) safeguards California's people, property, and over 31 million acres of wildlands. It provides fire protection, all-hazard emergency response, and forest stewardship, including prevention, vegetation management, and reforestation, serving communities statewide, including the Far North region.

name: Northeastern Rural Health
description: Northeastern Rural Health Clinics provides comprehensive medical, dental, and behavioral health services, including urgent care and primary care, to Lassen County. As the largest outpatient care provider in the region, it serves over 50,000 patients annually, accepting various insurance plans and offering sliding fee discounts.

name: Banner Lassen Medical Center
description: Banner Lassen Medical Center, a 25-bed critical access hospital in Susanville, California, provides outstanding clinical care and patient experience. It offers a wide range of programs and services including emergency, imaging, maternity, and surgery, focusing on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of illness.

name: Caito Fisheries
description: Caito Fisheries is a wholesale seafood dealer operating across California, with locations in Fort Bragg, San Francisco, Crescent City, Half Moon Bay, and Eureka. They specialize in seafood products, including Dungeness Crab, serving businesses in the region.

name: Constellation Brands
description: Constellation Brands is a multinational producer and marketer of beer, wine, and spirits.

name: Fetzer Vineyards
description: Fetzer Vineyards produces a variety of wines, including Gewürztraminer, Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinot Grigio, Riesling, Merlot, and Sauvignon Blanc. As a Certified B Corp, the company is committed to sustainable practices, caring for its workers, communities, and the environment. They serve consumers seeking good wines for various occasions.

name: Mendocino Community Health
description: Mendocino Community Health is a healthcare organization providing services to the community.

name: Adventist Health Mendocino
description: Adventist Health Mendocino Coast provides award-winning healthcare services, including primary care, emergency care, cancer care, and surgery, to Fort Bragg and surrounding communities. Their team of caregivers focuses on quality and patient experience, offering personalized, whole-person services to inspire health and wholeness.

name: Pacific Medical Resources
description: Eternal Medical Resources and Eternal Homecare Solutions provides home health care services, serving the elderly, veterans, disabled, and vulnerable members of the community across Mendocino, Lake, Humboldt, Del Norte, and Sonoma counties in California. They offer personalized care plans, 24/7 RN support, and advanced technology for monitoring and management.

name: Adventist Health Ukiah Valley
description: Adventist Health Ukiah Valley is a faith-based healthcare provider serving Mendocino County, California. It offers a wide range of services including emergency care, cancer care, heart and vascular care, maternity, orthopedics, and primary care, aiming to inspire health, wholeness, and hope in the community.

name: Thurston Toyota
description: Thurston Toyota is a new and used car dealership in Ukiah, CA, serving areas like Willits, Fort Bragg, Lakeport, and Kelseyville. They offer sales of Toyota vehicles, financing options, and comprehensive car service and repair, including parts, to individual customers.

name: Ukiah City Civic Center
description: The City of Ukiah Civic Center provides municipal services including utility services, parks and recreation, public safety, and infrastructure improvements. It serves residents and businesses in Ukiah, California, focusing on sustainable practices, economic development, and community well-being.

name: Heritage House Resort & Spa
description: The Heritage House Resort & Spa is a cliffside retreat on the Mendocino coast, offering accommodations, dining with ocean views, a spa, and venues for weddings and events. It serves guests seeking luxury and relaxation in Northern California.

name: Little River Inn
description: Little River Inn is a family-owned hospitality business operating for over 80 years on the Mendocino Coast of California. It offers over sixty rooms with ocean views, dining options including a restaurant and bar, an Audubon-certified golf course, and event spaces for weddings and corporate events.

name: US Forest Service - Modoc National Forest
description: Modoc National Forest, located in California's northeastern corner, is a U.S. government organization managing diverse landscapes including volcanic Cascades, Warner Mountains, and the Devil's Garden Wild Horse Territory. It serves the public by offering recreational opportunities like hiking, fishing, and OHV use, managing natural resources, and overseeing wild horse adoption programs.

name: Seneca Healthcare District
description: Seneca Healthcare District is a Critical Access Hospital and Rural Health Clinic serving the Lake Almanor area of California. It provides comprehensive inpatient and outpatient care, including a 10-bed acute hospital, 24/7 emergency services, a 16-bed skilled nursing facility, and a walk-in clinic with diagnostic imaging, surgical, and therapy services.

name: Vibra Hospital of Northern California
description: Vibra Hospital of Northern California, part of Vibra Healthcare, provides critical care, medical rehabilitation, and skilled nursing services in Redding, CA. It serves patients recovering from serious injuries, illnesses, and debilitating medical conditions, offering personalized treatment plans and compassionate care.

name: Mayers Memorial Hospital Burney
description: Mayers Memorial Healthcare District provides comprehensive, patient-focused healthcare services, including acute care, emergency services, outpatient care, skilled nursing, and telemedicine. name: Mayers Memorial Hospital District
description: Mayers Memorial Healthcare District provides comprehensive, patient-focused healthcare services, including acute care, emergency, surgical, and outpatient services. It serves the Intermountain Community in the Far North region of California, offering quality and compassionate care to its residents.

name: Klamath National Forest
description: The Klamath National Forest and Butte Valley National Grassland manage 1.7 million acres in Northern California and Southern Oregon, offering diverse recreation like camping, hiking, and wildlife watching. They focus on forest health, fire prevention, and natural resource management, serving the public and local communities.

name: Siskiyou County Public Works
description: Siskiyou County Public Works constructs and maintains 1,361 miles of roadways and 175 bridges in unincorporated Siskiyou County. They also manage the County's fleet system and provide engineering and surveying services, serving the residents and infrastructure needs of the county.

name: Mount Shasta Resort
description: Mount Shasta Resort is an all-season resort in Far Northern California, offering lodging in private forest chalets, an 18-hole golf course, and exceptional dining at Highland House Restaurant. It serves guests seeking outdoor recreation, leisure, and event hosting, providing amenities like a day spa and a family-friendly lounge.

name: Crain Walnut Shelling
description: Crain Walnut Shelling, LP is one of California's largest family-owned producers, packers, and processors of quality English Walnuts. They serve industrial ingredient and export markets in the U.S. and internationally, supported by marketing agreements with over 500 growers.

name: Bell-Carter Foods
description: Bell-Carter Foods, founded in 1912, is one of the world's largest table olive producers, employing nearly 300 people. They provide innovative olive products and services to retailers and foodservice organizations, focusing on quality and customer success.

name: St Elizabeth Community Hospital
description: Dignity Health is a nonprofit healthcare organization operating over 40 hospitals and 400 care centers across California, Arizona, and Nevada. It provides high-quality, affordable healthcare services, including urgent, occupational, imaging, home health, and primary care, serving millions with a patient-centered approach.

name: Tehama County Health Services Agency
description: Tehama County Health Services Agency is an integrated agency addressing the health and human service needs of Tehama County residents. It offers behavioral health, primary medical, public health, and substance use recovery services, serving all age groups from children to seniors through education, prevention, assessment, and treatment.

name: Corning Ford
description: Corning Ford is a Ford dealership in Corning, CA, serving drivers across the Bay Area, Sacramento, San Jose, Napa, Tehama County, Red Bluff, and Chico, CA. They sell new and pre-owned Ford vehicles, including trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, and offer auto financing, parts, and maintenance services.

description: Rolling Hills Casino and Resort is a hospitality and entertainment destination in Corning, California, offering a casino with slots and table games, hotels, an RV park, diverse dining, an equestrian center, and a golf course. It serves travelers and visitors seeking gaming, lodging, and recreation.

name: USDA Forest Service
description: The USDA Forest Service manages national forests and grasslands, focusing on land management, fire management, and natural resource conservation. It serves the public through recreation opportunities and works with partners on initiatives like shared stewardship, addressing issues such as wildfire risk and water protection across the U.S.

name: Trinity River Lumber
description: Trinity River Lumber Company, a full-scale softwood mill in Weaverville, California, has been locally owned and operated since 1983. It specializes in producing 2" and 4" wane-free home center products, including Douglas Fir and Hem Fir, in lengths 8' to 20', primarily serving the California housing market.
